Introduction
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Technical Architect
   

  

**About SymphonyAI Retail:**
 SymphonyAI Retail is a leading provider of advanced AI\-driven solutions and services specifically designed for the retail industry. We empower retailers and consumer packaged goods (CPG) companies with innovative technology to enhance their operations, optimize decision\-making, and deliver exceptional customer experiences. SymphonyAI Retail is a global leader in the supply of integrated business solutions to organizations worldwide, serving 30 of the top 50 global grocery retailers and numerous consumer brands.
   

  

**Overview:**
 We are seeking a highly experienced Technical Architect for the SCM GOLD platform to lead the design and delivery of complex retail supply chain implementations. This role requires deep expertise across both functional supply chain processes and technical architecture, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable solution designs. The Architect will work closely with clients, Professional Services, R\&D, and partner teams to ensure successful implementation, integration, and deployment of SCM GOLD solutions across large\-scale retail environments. This role is critical for high\-visibility programs and will provide architectural leadership from solution design through implementation, UAT, and production cutover.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Solution Architecture \& Design:**
* Lead end\-to\-end solution architecture for SCM GOLD implementations, ensuring alignment with client business goals and SymphonyAI product capabilities.
* Translate complex retail supply chain requirements into scalable functional and technical solution designs.
* Define system architecture, integration frameworks, and configuration strategy across SCM GOLD modules.
* Guide design decisions across forecasting, replenishment, inventory optimization, and supply chain planning capabilities.


**Technical Leadership:**
* Provide hands\-on architectural guidance for system configuration, customization, integrations, and performance optimization.
* Partner closely with R\&D teams to ensure product capabilities align with client requirements and implementation strategy.
* Support technical teams in resolving complex implementation challenges and architectural trade\-offs.
* Ensure best practices across data architecture, APIs, and system integrations.


**Client and Stakeholder Engagement:**
* Lead technical and functional discussions with client executives, program leaders, and technical teams.
* Act as the primary architecture authority during design workshops, solution reviews, and executive checkpoints.
* Provide architectural guidance during UAT, testing cycles, and production deployment.
* Support client change management and adoption of SCM GOLD capabilities.


**Program Delivery Support:**
* Collaborate with Professional Services, Partner Delivery teams, and Implementation Leads to ensure solution integrity throughout the program lifecycle.
* Provide oversight during key delivery phases including design validation, system build, UAT readiness, and production cutover.
* Support risk mitigation and architectural governance for complex implementations.


**Technical Skills:**
* Hands\-on experience in:
+ Solid understanding of System Design \& Architecture and Integration.
+ Solid understanding of Java (core Java).
+ Solid understanding of REST APIs.
+ Solid understanding of database concepts (preferably Oracle), SQL, and PL/SQL.
+ Solid understanding of Shell scripting.
+ Fair understanding of JavaScript/HTML/CSS\-based applications implementation.
+ Basic understanding of Vue/React\-based applications implementation.


**Other Experience:**
* 10\+ years of experience in retail supply chain technology implementations.
* Deep expertise in SymphonyAI SCM GOLD platform (technical and functional) is a plus but not essential.
* Proven experience designing and delivering large\-scale supply chain planning solutions.
* Strong understanding of retail planning, forecasting, replenishment, and inventory optimization processes.
* Experience working across solution architecture, system integration, and enterprise deployment.
* Ability to lead complex client\-facing discussions with both business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience collaborating with product teams, delivery teams, and global partners.
* Good understanding of cloud platforms.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience delivering large enterprise retail transformation programs.
* Strong background in supply chain data architecture and system integration.
* Experience supporting UAT, testing governance, and deployment strategies.
* Ability to mentor implementation teams and guide architectural best practices.


**Diversity \& Inclusion Statement:**
 We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
   

  

**About Us**
 SymphonyAI is building the leading enterprise AI SaaS company for digital transformation across the most critical and resilient growth industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, financial crime prevention, manufacturing, media, and enterprise IT. Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI has grown to today serve 2000\+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 2,500 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries.

Overview  
At Western Union, we’re more than a trusted name in global payments. We’re moving beyond remittances, beyond cash, and beyond the expectations of our customers.  


Our talented teams enable us to transform into a digital\-first company, built on the strength of our retail foundation and powered by next\-generation payments. All this with the goal of helping people prosper.  


Our customers inspire us to push boundaries and create services that make life easier and communities stronger. Wherever you are in the world, we’re committed to shaping the next generation of financial experiences.  


Join us as we go beyond and be part of a team that’s redefining what’s possible.  
Role Responsibilities  


At Western Union, reliability is a product feature. Our customers depend on our platforms to move money securely and seamlessly across the globe, and every second of availability matters.  


We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Site Reliability Engineering organization and help shape the future of reliability, resilience, and operational excellence across our most critical platforms that support millions of transactions every day. This is not a traditional production support role. You will lead teams that apply software engineering principles to operations, building automated, self\-healing, highly observable systems feature that scale globally and operate with exceptional reliability and accelerate innovation through automation and AI\-driven operational practices.  


This role offers a unique opportunity to influence enterprise\-wide reliability strategy, modernize operational capabilities, and build a high\-performing engineering culture across globally distributed teams supporting highly regulated financial services and compliance platforms.  


You will also –  


* Lead and mentor Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, and Production Support teams.
* Establish reliability, scalability, and operational excellence standards across critical platforms.
* Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, innovation, and engineering excellence.
* Drive adoption of modern SRE practices, automation frameworks, and AI\-assisted operations.

Reliability \& Platform Engineering  


* Define, measure, and improve Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Error Budgets.
* Improve system reliability, availability, resilience, scalability, and performance.
* Lead capacity planning, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives.
* Design and implement proactive monitoring, observability, and anomaly detection capabilities.

Production Operations \& Service Management  


* Own and evolve the L2/L3 production support operating model.
* Lead and Support Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management processes.
* Drive rapid incident response, service restoration, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with established SLAs, SLOs, operational controls, and audit requirements.

Automation \& Operational Excellence  


* Reduce operational toil through automation and self\-healing capabilities.
* Identify and eliminate manual processes through engineering improvements and workflow optimization.
* Implement AI\-powered operational insights and incident investigation capabilities.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on stability, efficiency, and cost optimization.

Stakeholder \& Business Partnership  


* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Compliance, and Business Operations teams.
* Communicate service health, operational risks, and reliability metrics to senior leadership.
* Manage relationships with managed service providers and strategic technology partners.
* Support highly regulated financial services, payments, risk, fraud, and compliance platforms.

Role Requirements  


Leadership \& Experience  


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, IT, or similar preferred  
12\+ years in Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or SRE.  
5\+ years managing SRE, Platform, or Production Support teams.  
Experience leading 8\-15\+ engineers across multiple workstreams.  
Proven experience supporting enterprise applications in Agile environments.  
Experience leading global support teams supporting business\-critical applications.  
Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.  


Site Reliability Engineering  


Deep expertise in modern SRE practices, including SLOs, SLIs, Error Budgets, capacity planning, resiliency, and reliability engineering.  
Demonstrated success by reducing operational toil through automation and building systems that are reliable by design.  
Experience leading incident management, blameless postmortems, and continuous reliability improvement programs.  


AWS Cloud , Platform \& DevOps  


Strong hands\-on experience designing and operating cloud\-native platforms on AWS, including EKS/ECS, EC2, IAM, API Gateway, S3, and related services.  
Expertise in Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), CI/CD, DevSecOps, and platform engineering.  
Passion for building self\-service platforms and enabling teams to move faster with confidence.  
Experience leveraging AI\-assisted engineering and operations tools such as GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q, or equivalent AI tools to improve developer productivity and service reliability.  
Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Shell) and familiarity with automation tools (such as Ansible, Jenkins).  


Observability \& Operational Excellence  


Experience implementing observability strategies using tools such as Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenSearch.  
Strong understanding of incident response, disaster recovery, production readiness, performance engineering, and operational risk management.  
Ability to establish meaningful reliability metrics and drive data\-informed operational decisions.  


Technical Foundation  


Linux Administration, API troubleshooting , Distributed Systems , Networking fundamentals , Performance Engineering  


Domain Expectations (Mandatory)  


Preferred Industry Background  


* Experience operating mission\-critical platforms in Financial Services, Payments, Banking, FinTech, Fraud, Risk, or AML environments.

Familiarity with security, compliance, audit, and regulatory requirements associated with highly regulated, high\-availability systems.  


Nice\-to\-Have Skills  


Advanced Reliability Engineering  


Experience with Chaos Engineering, fault\-injection testing, resilience validation, and large\-scale performance benchmarking.  
Experience driving reliability transformation or SRE maturity initiatives across enterprise organizations.  


Work Shift  


Western Union values in\-person collaboration, problem solving, and ideation whenever possible. We believe this fosters common ways of working and supports how we execute initiatives for our customers. The expectation is to work from the office a minimum of three days a week.  


BENEFITS AND OTHER DETAILS  


Benefits  


You will also have access to short\-term incentives, multiple health insurance options, accident and life  
insurance, and access to best\-in\-class development platforms, to name a few. Please see the benefits below specific to your country. If applicable, additional role\-specific benefits will be mentioned during your interview process or in an offer of employment.

Other Details  


As part of the application process, all applicants are required to take assessments. Western Union has partnered with a 3rd party provider to administer these tests. bda88887.title: Program Manager - Component & Sub-systems
bda88887.description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Program Manager for Components \& Sub\-Systems is responsible for the full execution and delivery of a defined portion of a Fluence product or program — such as a hardware component, subsystem, software module, or technical workstream. This role ensures that assigned scope meets all requirements for timing, quality, cost, and readiness before integration into the broader program.
   

  

 This position requires strong leadership, cross\-functional coordination, and disciplined execution. Successful candidates will demonstrate the ability to independently drive outcomes within their scope while collaborating closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Product, and the Senior Program Manager. This role carries full accountability for execution of the assigned subsystem, including timing, quality, and readiness for integration into the full program. This role may include ownership of a software\-focused workstream, requiring close coordination with software engineering teams to ensure integration readiness, testing coverage, and software release alignment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end execution for an assigned component, subsystem, or workstream, from requirements alignment through production launch readiness.
* Develop and manage the detailed program plan for owned scope, including schedules, milestones, risks, dependencies, and mitigation actions.
* Ensure Engineering\-owned technical deliverables for the component/subsystem are completed on time and meet program requirements, while supporting clarity, tracking, and issue resolution. The PM ensures delivery but does not own technical content or engineering decision\-making.
* Coordinate interface definition and alignment with dependent or upstream/downstream subsystems to ensure seamless integration.
* Maintain rigorous tracking of progress, risks, issues, and dependencies; drive timely cross\-functional actions to stay on schedule.
* Translate customer, market, and platform requirements into clear objectives and workstream deliverables.
* Partner with Supply Chain to support procurement readiness, supplier engagement, long\-lead component planning, and launch\-critical material availability.
* Work with Operations and Manufacturing Engineering to ensure build readiness, coordinate validation activities, and support integration into production processes.
* Provide structured, data\-driven status updates for owned scope during Program Reviews, Stage\-Gates, and leadership syncs.
* Maintain accurate program documentation, dashboards, and communication tools to ensure visibility and alignment.
* Escalate risks quickly with recommended options for resolution; support decision\-making with well\-structured data.
* Model strong leadership, accountability, and proactive problem\-solving consistent with Fluence program management expectations.
* Proactively challenge assumptions and drive clarity in ambiguous or conflicting situations.
* Collaborate closely with global and regional Engineering, Supply Chain, and Operations teams.


**Qualifications**
* 3–7 years of experience in Program or Project Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, or similar roles managing technical deliverables or workstreams.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams and drive execution across hardware and/or software development environments.
* Experience with component\-level or subsystem\-level planning, procurement, supplier coordination, and production readiness preferred.
* Strong schedule management, risk management, and communication skills.
* Ability to operate with ownership and independence while maintaining alignment with the broader program organization.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with evolving priorities and complex dependencies.
* Ability to work closely with global teams across time zones, ensuring seamless communication and alignment.
* Experience working within global engineering organizations and/or multinational product development environments.
* Proven ability to lead without direct authority and drive cross\-functional outcomes.
* Understanding of embedded systems, APIs, and cross\-component software interactions preferred.
* Experience managing software or firmware development workstreams, including familiarity with SDLC, backlog management, software integration, and validation processes.
* Ability to coordinate with software engineering teams across Agile frameworks and ensure alignment between software deliverables and overall program milestones.
* Certifications (PMP, Agile, Lean) a plus but not required.


**Required Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, or a related technical field required.
* Advanced degree a plus but not required.


**Candidates who have applied within the past three months need not apply.**
 Qualified candidates are requested to submit a resume and cover letter at careers@fluenceenergy.com for consideration.
   

  

**Our Culture**
 At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world.
   

  

**Unleash Voices**
 We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress.
   

  

**Customer Fluent**
 Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate.
   

  

**Infinite Impact**
 We are committed to creating the impossible. We push boundaries to deliver sustainable, game\-changing solutions that shape a brighter, more energy\-efficient future for all. Our team is passionate about making a lasting impact that will resonate for generations to come.
   

  

**All In**
 We are all in for growth. Our teams are relentlessly focused on identifying and seizing opportunities that propel us forward. We embrace an ownership mindset, pushing ourselves and each other to accelerate progress and create lasting success.

a224e239.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
a224e239.description:
**Overview**  

GitHub is seeking a passionate, driven, and collaborative Senior TPM to drive the GitHub Enterprise Servier (GHES) release process. This includes OS and container builds across the platform, infrastructure, and application layers; package generation and certification; integration test environments; and distribution of release artifacts through Azure and other clouds. In this role, you will define operational priorities for the team, coordinate execution across a complex release surface, and partner across engineering organizations to ensure GHES ships as a high\-quality, secure, and dependable appliance for enterprise customers.


You will partner with stakeholders to deliver solutions that strengthen our security posture and elevate service resiliency and quality. Additionally, you will coordinate with engineers across the organization to monitor progress, resolve blockers, and provide status updates to the leadership team.


Our team is small, efficient, and engineering\-focused, thriving in a fast\-paced environment. We are looking for a Senior TPM who embraces new challenges and adapts quickly to evolving programs. To support multiple initiatives simultaneously, you will leverage AI to boost productivity and continuously seek opportunities to enhance engineering efficiency through agentic AI\-based solutions.


To be successful in the role, the ideal candidate will require strong interpersonal skills, influencing without authority, drive for results, and collaboration in addition to a proven track record in technical program management and operational excellence.

 **Responsibilities**  

The Technical Program Manager Role encompasses a broad scope including:

* Drive execution across build, package generation, validation, certification, and customer delivery workflows for GHES releases.
* Establish and drive standards for release reliability, observability, compliance, and operational excellence across build, release, and certification workflows.
* Set investment priorities for the GHES Release team, balancing immediate delivery needs with long\-term improvements in reliability, efficiency, and engineering velocity.
* Ensure strong operational ownership of release infrastructure, including clear accountability, effective incident response, and continuous improvement following critical issues.
* Drive and deliver security and compliance requirements.
* Negotiate requirements with the central teams (SMEs).
* Understand best practices and available tooling to improve service resiliency and quality.
* Influence and drive adoption of quality best practices and standards.
* Drive onboarding to central infra services and, tooling.
* Track various metrics across broad set of services.
* Drive tooling and infra feature design and implementation.
* Identify new opportunities and work with the central teams to supplement existing quality standards.
* Deliver technical and high\-level presentations in various forums.
* Drive multiple projects at any given time.
 **Qualifications**  

Required Qualifications:

* 5\+ years of experience as a Technical Program Manager or in a technical role with systems experience.
* 3\+ years of experience working in the Cloud domain.
* 3\+ year of experience in management of complex cross\-group, cross\-business, cross\-disciplinary projects.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Strong technical problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Good understanding of cloud services best practices.
* Good understanding of cloud architecture, telemetry, and monitoring systems.
* Experience with high\-availability systems and services resiliency.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proven ability to influence without authority and drive results across teams.
* Negotiation skills to drive repair items/investments with engineering managers. Knows trade\-offs.
* 4\-years degree in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/EE or equivalent experience.

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:


Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.


Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request via the Accommodation request form.


Benefits/perks listed below may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Microsoft and the country where you work.

  

  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

eb90b124.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
eb90b124.description:
Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI, and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help organizations improve efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences across industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world’s \#1 AI\-driven automation software provider within the next five years.
 


  


 We work with leading companies such as the SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali, and others to enhance customer interactions and automate business processes using our cutting\-edge Conversational AI technology.
 


  


 Our global team includes more than 70 highly skilled professionals from diverse backgrounds.
 


  


 We foster an open, progressive company culture with state\-of\-the\-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you’ll experience a unique blend of passion, purpose, challenge, and fun.
 


  


 We’re growing rapidly across Europe and looking for a
 **Senior Solutions Engineer** 
 who combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen to help our customers succeed.
 


  

 Tasks
   


 As a
 **Senior Solutions Engineer** 
 , you’ll act as the technical backbone of our sales and customer engagement process. You’ll collaborate with Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to design, present, and deliver impactful automation solutions. This role blends hands\-on technical work with strategic engagement — ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of technology, business value, and customer experience.
 


  


**Key Responsibilities** 



  


**Pre\-Sales \& Technical Enablement** 



  

  
* Partner with the Sales team to understand customer requirements and design tailored AI automation solutions using Enterprise Bot’s platform.
  
* Deliver compelling product demos, proof\-of\-concepts (POCs), and presentations that clearly communicate technical and business value.
  
* Lead technical discovery sessions and develop architecture proposals and integration plans.
  


  


**Solution Design \& Delivery** 



  

  
* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solution architectures.
  
* Collaborate with Engineering teams during pilots and implementations to ensure seamless technical delivery.
  
* Provide technical validation and support during critical phases of the sales cycle.
  


  


**Customer Engagement \& Partnership** 



  

  
* Build trusted relationships with customers by acting as a technical advisor throughout the engagement.
  
* Ensure customer success by proactively identifying risks and helping resolve technical challenges.
  
* Be available to support key customer engagements or escalations when necessary.
  


  


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



  

  
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to align roadmap priorities with customer feedback.
  
* Contribute to technical enablement materials, training sessions, and playbooks to strengthen overall sales effectiveness.
  
* Advocate for customer needs within the organization and help improve solution delivery processes.
  


  


**Thought Leadership \& Market Engagement** 



  

  
* Represent Enterprise Bot at industry events, webinars, and conferences.
  
* Stay up to date on AI automation trends, cloud technologies, and emerging best practices in the B2B SaaS landscape.
  
* Contribute to positioning Enterprise Bot as a trusted technology partner and thought leader in intelligent automation.
  


  

 Requirements
   

  
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
  
* 5\+ years of experience in Pre\-Sales, Solutions Engineering, or similar roles, with at least 2 years at a senior level.
  
* Proven track record in B2B SaaS or AI\-automation environments (experience with conversational AI, RPA, or cloud\-based automation is a strong plus).
  
* Experience with voice technologies such as ACD and IVR workflows is a must.
  
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
  
* Highly fluent in the English language \- both verbal and written
  
* Strong understanding of enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, cloud infrastructure, APIs, etc.).
  
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills.
  
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and perform under pressure in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
  


  


**Preferred Qualifications** 



  

  
* Hands\-on experience with CRM or presales tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
  
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, and related certifications.
  
* Understanding of NLP, automation workflows, or integration frameworks (e.g., REST, GraphQL).
  
* Experience in enterprise\-scale solution delivery and customer success collaboration.
  


  

 Benefits
   

  
* Be part of a rapidly growing company at the forefront of AI automation and conversational AI solutions used by leading global enterprises.
  
* Shape solutions that make a measurable impact for Fortune 500 clients and leading European enterprises.
  
* A culture comprised of diverse, global teams who have a passion for collaboration, creativity, and excellence in client service
  
* A competitive salary and scope for further advancement.
  
* A great environment that promotes open feedback and a flat hierarchy, working at Enterprise Bot is a refreshing mix of purpose, challenge, and fun.

7b320895.title: Solution Area Specialists - Windows & Devices
7b320895.description:
**Overview**
 With a vision to
 **build and sell Microsoft AI‑powered platforms, cloud services, and devices through a rich partner ecosystem** 
 , the
 **Windows and Device Sales (WDS)** 
 organization brings together sales, technical expertise, and partners to help customers achieve real business outcomes with Microsoft technology.
   

  

 WDS plays a critical role in shaping and delivering the endpoint platform that powers modern, secure, and AI‑enabled work. WDS works across Microsoft’s commercial ecosystem, including OEMs, silicon partners, distributors, resellers, and services partners \- to drive Windows platform adoption, protect and grow share, and ensure customers realize long‑term value from their device and endpoint investments.
   

  

 This role contributes to a
 **multi‑billion‑dollar business** 
 and plays a direct role in
 **defending and expanding Windows as the enterprise endpoint platform** 
 , enabling customers to modernize their environments, adopt AI‑driven workflows, and build confidence in Windows as the foundation for future innovation.
   

  

 As a Windows Specialist, you will defend and grow Windows within Microsoft’s largest and most strategic customers. You will help them define and modernize their endpoint strategy in an era shaped by AI, security threats, and rapid platform competition. You will operate as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business leaders \- anchoring engagement with the CIO while expanding influence across CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders \- to ensure Windows remains the foundational platform for secure, AI‑driven work.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead high‑impact, time‑bound customer engagements where Windows platform decisions are at risk or strategically critical. You will articulate differentiated Windows value across security, resiliency, management, and AI workloads; orchestrate partners and internal teams to deliver proof and outcomes; and convert lighthouse wins into repeatable evidence that scales across industries and partners.
   

  

 This opportunity will allow you to deepen executive‑level consultative skills, build technical and platform credibility across the Windows ecosystem, and play a visible role in protecting and expanding Microsoft’s commercial footprint in priority accounts.
   

  

 \[
 *This role is flexible in that you can work partially from home* 
 ]
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead Windows endpoint strategy with senior executives: Leverage you technical expertise to lead strategic Windows discussions with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs and AI leaders, translating technology capabilities into business value.
* Defend and extend Windows in competitive environments, deepen insights on why customers adopt alternative platforms, articulate fact based \& differentiated platform value to protect the Windows socket.
* Modernize endpoint management and identity architectures, helping customers decouple from legacy environments, improve total cost of ownership, and unlock AI‑driven workflows at scale.
* Lead high‑impact customer engagements across discovery, envisioning, proof, and value realization, with clear entry criteria, success measures, and exit plans.
* Deliver lighthouse wins that demonstrate real Windows AI value, converting customer outcomes into evidence such as case studies, reference architectures, and repeatable industry scenarios.
* Orchestrate across internal teams and partners, working closely with account teams, engineering, and OEM/channel partners to ensure clarity of roles, clear hand\-offs, escalation process, and accelerated outcomes.
* Provide structured feedback and insights from customer engagements to inform product, go‑to‑market, and partner strategy, identifying patterns that can scale across similar customers.


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications (RQs)**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field AND 8\+ years of customer‑facing experience in enterprise technology, consultative selling, Specialist, solution architecture, or transformation‑focused roles OR
* Equivalent professional experience.
* Demonstrated capability and experience in leading technical and executive‑level customer conversations, translating complex platform concepts into clear, outcome‑oriented guidance for CIO, CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders.
* Prior background in technical sales, solutions architecture, GBB or platform Specialist roles, where credibility across both business outcomes and technical depth was required.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Security and compliance technologies, including Microsoft Defender, Entra, Purview, identity and access management, and Zero Trust principles, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value and risk reduction outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications (PQs)**
* Strong Windows platform expertise, including Windows Pro and Windows 11 Enterprise, with the ability to articulate differentiated value across security, manageability, performance, and AI for enterprise and commercial customers.
* Experience advising customers on Windows 11 lifecycle strategy, including hardware refresh planning, security posture improvements, and operational readiness.
* Proven experience of modern endpoint management and workplace transformation strategies with expertise in Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager and cloud\-native management. Able to advise senior leaders on device management modernization, security, operational efficiency and AI readiness, guiding customers through strategic platform decisions and transformation roadmaps.
* Strong understanding of AI\-ready Windows devices, including Copilot\+ PCs, NPUs and specialized AI silicon. Able to translate platform and hardware innovation into measurable business outcomes, productivity gains and competitive advantage for customers evaluating next\-generation endpoint strategies.


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. 531906c3.title: Cloud Architect Lead, Data & AI Platforms (GCP)
531906c3.description:
We know that the only way a business thrive is if our people are growing. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?


At Siemens, we're not just building technology; we're building the future. As a global powerhouse focusing on electrification, automation, and digitalization, we're constantly innovating to address the world's most pressing challenges. Join our dynamic team and be a part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and making a real impact.


We are seeking a highly experienced and visionary Cloud Architect Lead to spearhead the design, development, and implementation of our next\-generation data and AI platforms on Google Cloud (GCP). The ideal candidate will be a technical leader with a proven track record of architecting and delivering robust, scalable, and secure cloud\-native solutions in enterprise environments. You will be instrumental in driving our AI adoption strategy, leading complex technical projects, and mentoring a team of talented engineers. If you're passionate about leveraging cutting\-edge cloud and AI technologies to transform businesses, we want to hear from you!


We are looking for Cloud Architect, Data and AI Platforms


**You’ll make a difference by:**

* 8\+ years of experience in software engineering, with a significant focus on cloud architecture, data engineering, and DevOps.
* Proven hands\-on experience in designing and building solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Deep expertise in core GCP services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Run, GKE, and Cloud Functions.
* Extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), particularly with Terraform.
* Strong background in data engineering and building scalable data pipelines with tools like Apache Spark, Airflow, and similar technologies.
* Solid understanding of security principles and best practices in the cloud, including IAM, OIDC, and network security.
* Excellent programming skills in languages such as Python or Scala. C\# is a plus.
* Experience with building and deploying AI and machine learning solutions, particularly with Vertex AI, Agentic AI, and RAG architectures.
* Experience in corporate IT.
* Familiarity with FinOps principles and cost optimization strategies in the cloud.
* Relevant Google Cloud certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Data Engineer).

**You’d describe yourself as:**

* Architectural Leadership: Lead the end\-to\-end architecture and design of enterprise\-grade data and AI platforms on Google Cloud Platform, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and resilient.
* Data \& AI Platform Development: Design and oversee the implementation of advanced data engineering solutions, including ETL/ELT pipelines, data lakes, and data warehouses. Architect and build platforms for Generative AI, including solutions based on Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic AI frameworks.
* Cloud\-Native Engineering: Drive the development of cloud\-native applications and microservices using serverless and containerized technologies such as Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) \& DevOps: Champion and implement best practices for IaC using Terraform to automate the provisioning and management of cloud infrastructure. Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines for continuous integration and delivery.
* Security \& Governance: Architect and enforce robust security and governance frameworks for all cloud solutions. Implement security best practices for identity and access management (IAM), data encryption (KMS), and network security. Ensure compliance with internal and external audit requirements.
* Technical Strategy \& Innovation: Evaluate emerging technologies in the AI and cloud space, lead proof\-of\-concept (PoC) initiatives, and provide strategic recommendations to guide the evolution of our technical landscape.
* Collaboration \& Mentorship: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including business stakeholders, data scientists, and software engineers, to deliver scalable enterprise solutions. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.

**Create a better \#TomorrowWithUs!**


This role, based in Bangalore or Pune, is an individual contributor position. You may be required to visit other locations within India and internationally. In return, you'll have the opportunity to work with teams shaping the future.


At Siemens, we are a collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time, worldwide. We are dedicated to equality and welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.


Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow

**Find out more about Siemens careers at:** **www.siemens.com/careers**

43b571d4.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY GDS – EBS DBA / OCI Senior Position**
 Over the last decade, enterprise application modernization and cloud adoption have become critical to ensuring scalability, availability, and cost optimization for global organizations. To support this fast paced and evolving digital landscape, EY leverages Oracle E Business Suite (EBS) expertise combined with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and automation driven database practices to deliver secure, high performance, and resilient solutions for mission critical business applications.
   

  

 As part of our global EY GDS team, you will work as a Senior EBS DBA / OCI professional, supporting large scale Oracle EBS environments across on premises and cloud deployments. You will be involved in solving complex technical challenges, including EBS migrations to OCI, database upgrades, high availability design, and performance optimization, while contributing to the development of next generation EBS and OCI platforms in a collaborative, international delivery environment.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are offering you a demanding role. You will use your advanced expertise in Oracle E Business Suite (EBS), Oracle Database, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) to deliver secure, scalable, and high availability solutions for mission critical enterprise applications. This position provides the opportunity to collaborate with global stakeholders and supporting large scale cloud migration, database modernization, and operational excellence initiatives.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Overseeing Oracle EBS database administration and OCI implementation, and identifying opportunities for performance, scalability, and availability improvements.
* Accountable for ensuring database standards, cloud architecture guidelines, and operational processes are followed across on premise and OCI environments.
* Act as the first level technical escalation point for EBS database and OCI related issues for mission critical systems.
* Perform and support end to end database and application migrations from on premises environments to OCI, guiding teams through design, execution, and stabilization.
* Responsible for technical decision making, solution design, environment optimization, and supporting implementation activities for EBS and Oracle database workloads.
* Accountable for collaborating with Cloud Infrastructure teams, supporting instance provisioning, virtual network design, routing rules, security configurations, and database deployments.


**Strong understanding of:**
* Oracle EBS R12 architecture and multi node environments
* Oracle Database upgrades (9i/10g/11g to 12c/18c/19c)
* OCI networking, security, and database services
* Production support and cross platform migrations
* Responsible for ensuring database configurations, operational guidelines, and technical documentation are maintained and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Support database upgrades, patching, maintenance, and performance tuning for Oracle databases (12c, 18c, 19c) running on on prem and OCI platforms.
* Perform gap analysis against best practices and recommend improvements related to database performance, availability, security, and cloud architecture.
* Identify at risk environments or migration challenges and work with relevant teams to mitigate risks proactively.
* Perform technical reviews and identify corrective actions to improve database reliability and operational efficiency.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team\-player and self\-started attitude.
* Ability to create documentation for Technical Proof of concept (POC).
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 2\-6 years of relevant experience in architecting, designing, implementing, and/or supporting highly distributed applications.
* Extensive experience working on at least one Public Cloud – Oracle/Azure/Google. Oracle Cloud is preferred .
* BTech / MTech / MCA / MBA
* Technical lead for engagements such as Proof of Concepts and Architectural Design Sessions to define and design a complete solution using best practices on Oracle Cloud
* System administration experience (Linux, Solaris)


**Additionally, Good To Have**
* Certificated in Public Cloud – Oracle/AWS/Azure/Google Cloud Certified Architect Professional
* Technical – Experience in Designing, Developing, Deploying and/or Migrating mission critical business applications to Cloud environments including re\-platform of such systems
* Expertise in architecting best technical solutions based on customer requirement
* Experience giving presentations to executive audiences and explaining the benefits of the platform and service solution over competitors


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Possesses good communication skills to coordinate, resolve queries of both external and internal customers
* Self\-motivator and result oriented to complete task as per timelines
* Must have good analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Good written/Verbal Communication, Presentation, Interactive skills with team across geography.
* Flexible to work either independently or work in tandem with Cloud Infrastructure team to identify and implement the most efficient cloud\-based solutions for the company.


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1000\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Oracle and Enterprise Applications practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

44b07ef2.description:
We know that the only way a business thrive is if our people are growing. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?


At Siemens, we're not just building technology; we're building the future. As a global powerhouse focusing on electrification, automation, and digitalization, we're constantly innovating to address the world's most pressing challenges. Join our dynamic team and be a part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and making a real impact.


We are seeking a highly organized, customer\-centric, and financially minded Service Delivery Manager to oversee the operations, support, and financial health of Siemens' internal Enterprise AI portfolio. Instead of managing a single, dedicated platform or project, you will own the connective tissue across our entire AI ecosystem of services.


Acting as the operational champion, you will be the primary bridge between our platform engineers, SaaS vendors, and internal customers. You will establish robust service level agreements (SLAs), bring financial rigor (FinOps) to a diverse portfolio, and serve as the primary interface for internal Siemens stakeholders—including Cybersecurity (CYS), Legal \& Compliance, and Audit—ensuring our suite of AI services is secure, compliant, and continuously evolving. If you have a solid understanding of multi\-cloud environments, a passion for operational excellence, and a drive to influence the roadmap of cutting\-edge AI infrastructure, we want to hear from you!


We are looking for Service Delivery Manager, Enterprise AI

**You’ll make a difference by:**

* 5\+ years of experience in IT Service Management (ITSM), Cloud Operations, or Technical Program/Portfolio Management within a complex enterprise environment.
* Solid foundational understanding of multi\-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and GCP) to confidently discuss infrastructure and integration needs with internal customer teams.
* Proven track record of managing and improving multi\-service help desks, ticketing workflows (e.g., GitHub Projects, Jira Service Desk, ServiceNow), and establishing SLA/OLA frameworks.  

	+ Strong financial acumen with hands\-on experience in multi\-cloud cost management, budgeting, and FinOps methodologies.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience navigating complex enterprise governance, risk, and compliance frameworks (e.g., working with security, legal, and audit teams).
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate complex multi\-cloud, regulatory, or technical requirements into business\-friendly terms.
* Direct experience working with FinOps methodologies or holding a FinOps Certified Practitioner credential.
* Familiarity with multi\-cloud billing tools, cloud budgeting software, or SaaS consumption tracking tools.
* Strategic understanding of the enterprise AI operating layer, including LLM Gateways, specialized GCP architectures (Gemini, Vertex, Agents), and AI observability tools (such as Arize)

**You’d describe yourself as:**

* Portfolio Service Delivery \& Support Excellence: Own the end\-to\-end customer support lifecycle for our entire Enterprise AI portfolio. Establish, monitor, and continuously improve support processes, ticket resolution times, and customer satisfaction metrics to ensure internal Siemens teams receive world\-class, unified support across all services.
* Financial Management \& Portfolio FinOps: Act as the financial custodian of the portfolio. Own multi\-vendor budget forecasting, track monthly actuals versus budgets, manage the internal chargeback/showback mechanisms, and partner with engineering to execute cost\-optimization opportunities across hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SaaS models (OpenAI, Gemini Enterprise).
* Stakeholder \& Compliance Governance: Act as the primary point of contact for critical internal Siemens governance bodies, including Cybersecurity (CYS), Legal \& Compliance, and Audit. Ensure that our infrastructure templates, automated provisioning processes, and gateway routing rules comply with all internal policies, data privacy regulations, and audit controls.
* Roadmap Alignment \& Product Advocacy: Gather feedback, pain points, and feature requests from internal customer teams consuming enterprise AI. Translate these user needs and compliance requirements into actionable technical requirements, actively collaborating with product owners to influence the overall AI operating layer development roadmap.
* Operational Governance: Develop and maintain unified operational runbooks, service catalogs, and customer\-facing documentation. Facilitate regular service review meetings with internal customers and leadership to report on support SLAs, multi\-cloud platform usage trends, and portfolio financial health.

**Create a better \#TomorrowWithUs!**


This role, based in Bangalore or Pune, is an individual contributor position. You may be required to visit other locations within India and internationally. In return, you'll have the opportunity to work with teams shaping the future.


At Siemens, we are a collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time, worldwide. We are dedicated to equality and welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.


Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow

947ad655.title: Solutions Consultant
947ad655.description:
**Solution Consulting \& Customer Discovery:**
* Lead consultative discovery conversations to comprehend customer workflows, business challenges, and success metrics.
* Translate customer needs into tailored Adobe solution recommendations across Document Cloud and Creative Cloud offerings.
* Design and deliver impactful, customized product demonstrations aligned with customer use cases and industry context.
* Position Adobe solutions through value\-based storytelling, emphasizing productivity, collaboration, and workflow outcomes.


**Deal Strategy \& Sales Execution:**
* Collaborate closely with ICX Sales Advisors to advance opportunities throughout the sales cycle and support deal closure.
* Influence deal strategy by:
* Positioning solutions effectively
* Articulating use cases
* Discussing ROI and value
* Highlighting competitive differentiation
* Support pricing discussions, licensing clarity, procurement conversations, and objection handling.
* Drive momentum on opportunities to enhance pipeline conversion and opportunity closure ratios.


**Growth Product Acceleration:**
* Serve as the primary specialist resource for growth products like Acrobat Studio, Acrobat Express, Adobe Sign, and related offerings.
* Drive revenue impact through:
* Significant deal influence

d48c5f07.description:
**Overview**
 With a vision to
 **build and sell Microsoft AI‑powered platforms, cloud services, and devices through a rich partner ecosystem** 
 , the
 **Windows and Device Sales (WDS)** 
 organization brings together sales, technical expertise, and partners to help customers achieve real business outcomes with Microsoft technology.
   

  

 WDS plays a critical role in shaping and delivering the endpoint platform that powers modern, secure, and AI‑enabled work. WDS works across Microsoft’s commercial ecosystem, including OEMs, silicon partners, distributors, resellers, and services partners \- to drive Windows platform adoption, protect and grow share, and ensure customers realize long‑term value from their device and endpoint investments.
   

  

 This role contributes to a
 **multi‑billion‑dollar business** 
 and plays a direct role in
 **defending and expanding Windows as the enterprise endpoint platform** 
 , enabling customers to modernize their environments, adopt AI‑driven workflows, and build confidence in Windows as the foundation for future innovation.
   

  

 As a Windows Specialist, you will defend and grow Windows within Microsoft’s largest and most strategic customers. You will help them define and modernize their endpoint strategy in an era shaped by AI, security threats, and rapid platform competition. You will operate as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business leaders \- anchoring engagement with the CIO while expanding influence across CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders \- to ensure Windows remains the foundational platform for secure, AI‑driven work.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead high‑impact, time‑bound customer engagements where Windows platform decisions are at risk or strategically critical. You will articulate differentiated Windows value across security, resiliency, management, and AI workloads; orchestrate partners and internal teams to deliver proof and outcomes; and convert lighthouse wins into repeatable evidence that scales across industries and partners.
   

  

 This opportunity will allow you to deepen executive‑level consultative skills, build technical and platform credibility across the Windows ecosystem, and play a visible role in protecting and expanding Microsoft’s commercial footprint in priority accounts.
   

  

 \[
 *This role is flexible in that you can work partially from home* 
 ]
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead Windows endpoint strategy with senior executives: Leverage you technical expertise to lead strategic Windows discussions with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs and AI leaders, translating technology capabilities into business value.
* Defend and extend Windows in competitive environments, deepen insights on why customers adopt alternative platforms, articulate fact based \& differentiated platform value to protect the Windows socket.
* Modernize endpoint management and identity architectures, helping customers decouple from legacy environments, improve total cost of ownership, and unlock AI‑driven workflows at scale.
* Lead high‑impact customer engagements across discovery, envisioning, proof, and value realization, with clear entry criteria, success measures, and exit plans.
* Deliver lighthouse wins that demonstrate real Windows AI value, converting customer outcomes into evidence such as case studies, reference architectures, and repeatable industry scenarios.
* Orchestrate across internal teams and partners, working closely with account teams, engineering, and OEM/channel partners to ensure clarity of roles, clear hand\-offs, escalation process, and accelerated outcomes.
* Provide structured feedback and insights from customer engagements to inform product, go‑to‑market, and partner strategy, identifying patterns that can scale across similar customers.


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications (RQs)**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field AND 8\+ years of customer‑facing experience in enterprise technology, consultative selling, Specialist, solution architecture, or transformation‑focused roles OR
* Equivalent professional experience.
* Demonstrated capability and experience in leading technical and executive‑level customer conversations, translating complex platform concepts into clear, outcome‑oriented guidance for CIO, CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders.
* Prior background in technical sales, solutions architecture, GBB or platform Specialist roles, where credibility across both business outcomes and technical depth was required.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Security and compliance technologies, including Microsoft Defender, Entra, Purview, identity and access management, and Zero Trust principles, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value and risk reduction outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications (PQs)**
* Strong Windows platform expertise, including Windows Pro and Windows 11 Enterprise, with the ability to articulate differentiated value across security, manageability, performance, and AI for enterprise and commercial customers.
* Experience advising customers on Windows 11 lifecycle strategy, including hardware refresh planning, security posture improvements, and operational readiness.
* Proven experience of modern endpoint management and workplace transformation strategies with expertise in Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager and cloud\-native management. Able to advise senior leaders on device management modernization, security, operational efficiency and AI readiness, guiding customers through strategic platform decisions and transformation roadmaps.
* Strong understanding of AI\-ready Windows devices, including Copilot\+ PCs, NPUs and specialized AI silicon. Able to translate platform and hardware innovation into measurable business outcomes, productivity gains and competitive advantage for customers evaluating next\-generation endpoint strategies.


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. 329e7ec5.title: Cloud Solution Architect - Security
329e7ec5.description:
**Overview**
 With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE\&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross\-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in\-product, digital, or human\-centered. CE\&S is responsible for all up services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CE\&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.
   

  

 Our mission is to protect customers from cybersecurity threats. Our vision is to deliver a comprehensive AI\-driven security stack that provides best\-in\-class protection. Our Threat Protection strategy at Microsoft spans multiple products and services, providing state\-of\-the\-art protection across the entire digital estate. Our culture is centred on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life\-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world. You can help us to achieve our mission.
   

  

 We are looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA), specializing in Security who is passionate about driving our customers’ security transformation on the Purview Data Security, Sentinel and Defender XDR solutions and services. This is a customer\-facing role, owning the technical relationship between the customer and Microsoft, helping customers to leverage their Microsoft investments through architecture, implementation, and operational health engagements. Our Security CSAs work with Enterprise level customers on the bleeding edge of our Security solution stack.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a highly motivated and passionate Security Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) to drive customer transformation in our Security Solutions. You will own the customer engagements deliveries, including architecture design sessions, specific implementation project/pilots and helping to remove technical blockers. You will be driving successful customer security outcomes enabled by your design and engagement with key customer teams. The ideal candidate will have experience in customer\-facing roles, a background of deep technical expertise, and success building trusted advisor relationships with senior customer executives, Enterprise Architects, IT Management and Developers.
   

  

 Customer Centricity
   

  

* Customer Satisfaction \- Drive positive Customer Satisfaction \& become a trusted advisor.
* Customer/Partner Insights \- Provide feedback \& insights from customers/partners.
* Be the Voice of Customer to share insights and best practices, connect with Global Security teams at Microsoft, Engineering and Product teams to remove blockers and influence the solution roadmap.
* Land an end\-to\-end value prop for Security (i.e., Zero Trust) which spans the breadth of Microsoft Security offerings, and with focus on Threat Protection, ID \+ Access Management, Data Security and Cloud Security.


 Business Impact
   

  

* Position and deliver solutions that drive Security product usage and develop opportunities to drive Customer Success business results \& help Customers get value from their Microsoft investments.
* Identify resolutions to Customer blockers by leveraging SA subject matter expertise. Deliver according to MS best practices \& using repeatable IP.
* Accelerate Business Value of overall Security adoption by improving security posture and ensuring that the solution exhibits “Secure by Design” framework, such as high\-performance levels, security, scalability, maintainability, appropriate reusability, and reliability upon deployment.


 Technical Leadership
   

  

* Learn It All – Align individual skilling to team/area demands \& Customer Success goals.
* Accelerate customer outcomes \- Share expertise, contribute to IP creation \& re\-use to accelerate customer outcomes.
* Run Architectural Design Session to build a plan for implementing the solution – governing design in line with customer business goals and their technical environment. Outcome is consensus on solution design and next steps toward production.
* Collaborate and orchestrate with other Cloud Solution Architects and MS stakeholders in developing complex end\-to\-end Enterprise solutions with the Microsoft Security platform.
* Leverage the breadth of your technical experience and knowledge in foundational security, foundational AI, architecture design, with depth Subject Matter Expertise in security to deliver the end\-to\-end security story for Microsoft, highlighting the value proposition using your experience in security and expertise around related technologies and concepts such as Data Security, Zero Trust, threat management, SOC monitoring (SIEM / SOAR), Extended Detection \& Response (XDR) \+ SIEM, Cloud Security and Identity


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 7\+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience.
   

  

**Preferred/Additional Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate will have a breadth of knowledge across Microsoft Cloud security domains– SIEM \& XDR, Purview\- Data Security. Endpoint Security, Cloud Security, and Identity –Expertise/experience focused on:
   

  

* Purview Data Security – DLP, MIP and IRM
* Defender for Office (MDO)
* Microsoft Sentinel
* Microsoft Defender For Cloud (MDC)
* Defender for Endpoint (MDE
* Defender for Identity (MDI)
* Defender for Applications
* Identity\- Entra ID
* Breadth of technical security experience and knowledge, with depth and Subject Matter Expertise in one or more of the following domains:
* Data Security – DLP, MIP and IRM
* SIEM and Cloud Security Analytics
* Security Operations Center (SOC)
* Extended Detection and Response (XDR)
* Identity
* proven ability to map the customer’s needs to technical solutions.
* Strong technical understanding of Microsoft Security Solutions and of competitors.
* Empathy, curiosity, and desire to constantly improve, acquire new skills and drive for results.
* Demonstrated technical leadership in previous roles.
* Able to quickly resolve customer escalations by coordinating appropriate resources as needed.
* Certification in one or more of the following technologies preferred: Microsoft Security architecture, CISSP, CCSP or equivalent
* Business Value: The ability to convey the business need and value of proposed solutions, plans, and risks to stakeholders and decision makers. This includes the ability to persuade and inform based on facts and alignment with goals and strategy
* Trusted Advisership: The ability to build trusted advisor status and deep relationships across stakeholders (e.g., technical decision makers, business decision makers) through an understanding of customer needs and technologies.
* Situational fluency: Using self\-awareness as a mechanism to interpret verbal and non\-verbal cues to increase your ability to "read the room."
* Insightful listening: asking insightful questions to understand the customer needs, issues, business environment and drivers, and going beyond what is said.


 \#BRAVO2026
   

  

 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
 **requesting accommodations.**
