**Staff Technical Program Manager – Sports Tech**


**About Warner Bros. Discovery:**
 Warner Bros. Discovery is a global leader in entertainment, news, and sports, delivering brands like CNN, HLN, TNT, TBS, Adult Swim, Cartoon Network, Turner Sports, and more. Our innovations impact advertising, data management, information security, content creation and delivery, business operations, broadcasting, and ultimately, the fan experience.
   

  
 



 At Warner Bros. Discovery, we believe in the power of sports to bring people together, fuel passion and create unforgettable moments. The Global Sports Technology Platform team is the engine driving our sports streaming, content delivery and fan engagement technology — powering premium experiences for millions of fans around the world through brands like Bleacher Report, Eurosport, TNT Sports and March Madness.
   

 For more information, please visit www.wbd.com
   

  
   


**Meet Our Team:**
 WBD Sports encompasses a wide range of sports brands and channels, reaching over 130 million people monthly in more than 200 markets and 20\+ languages. Our key brands include Bleacher Report, Eurosport and TNT Sports. WBD Sports offers a comprehensive coverage of major sports events, like the Olympics in Europe, tennis Grand Slams and road cycling Grand Tours (e.g. Tour de France) across various platforms including TV and streaming services like Max and Discovery\+.
   

 Additionally, it manages and promotes 55 global events annually. TNT Sports UK features exclusive live sports such as the Premier League and UEFA Champions League.
 



**Roles \& Responsibilities:**




 We’re seeking a Staff Technical Program Manager to lead strategic, complex, and cross\-functional programs that power the delivery of world\-class sports experiences across our digital platforms. Based in Bengaluru, you will drive initiatives that span multiple teams and technical domains, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with business goals.
   

 This is a high\-impact leadership role for someone with deep technical program management expertise, strong stakeholder influence, and a passion for sports and technology.
   

  

**Strategic Program Leadership:**
 Drive large\-scale programs with multiple dependencies across engineering, product, operations, and editorial teams. Align initiatives with organizational goals and deliver high\-impact outcomes.
   

**Execution Excellence:**
 Own all phases of project delivery—from concept to launch. Adapt plans quickly in response to changing requirements or issues, and ensure timely, high\-quality execution.
   

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration:**
 Partner with internal and external stakeholders to define priorities, manage expectations, and coordinate deliverables across diverse teams.
   

**Problem Solving \& Risk Management:**
 Identify missing requirements, clarify ambiguous asks, and negotiate trade\-offs. Resolve complex issues independently and modify plans across portfolios when needed.
   

**Process Optimization:**
 Introduce scalable processes and eliminate inefficiencies. Lead post\-event retrospectives and apply insights to improve future executions.
   

 Influence \& Thought Leadership:
   

 Act as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor. Influence product direction, technical design, and operational improvements through data\-driven insights.
   

**Communication:**
 Communicate clearly and concisely across all levels—from engineers to executives.
   

 Produce technical design documents, executive status reports, and retrospectives tailored to diverse audiences.
   

**Mentorship \& Leadership:**
 Mentor Senior TPMs and junior team members. Provide input on team development and foster a culture of inclusion, growth, and excellence.
   

**Optional People Management:**
 If applicable, manage a small team of TPMs, guiding their professional development and performance.
 



  


**What to Bring:**
**Experience** 
 :
   

 10–14 years of program management experience in technology\-focused roles, ideally in digital media, streaming, or live sports platforms.
   

**Technical Acumen:**
 Strong understanding of software development processes, Devops, Agile methodologies, and tools like JIRA, Confluence, and Microsoft Suite. Background in engineering or technical architecture is a plus.
   

**Execution Skills:**
 Proven ability to manage complex programs independently, adapt to changing priorities, and deliver results efficiently.
   

**Communication:**
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Experience managing cross\-functional meetings and producing clear documentation.
   

**Collaboration \& Influence:**
 Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and influence across teams and levels.
   

**Passion for Sports \& Media:**
 Enthusiasm for sports and a desire to deliver exceptional fan experiences through technology.
   

  

**Why Join Us in Bengaluru?**
 Be part of a global team delivering iconic sports experiences from one of India’s leading tech hubs.
   

 Work on innovative technology powering live events and streaming platforms.
   

 Collaborate with passionate professionals in a dynamic, inclusive environment.
   

 Enjoy flexible working arrangements and career development opportunities.
   

  
   


**What We Offer:**



* A Great Place to work
* Equal opportunity employer
* Fast track growth opportunities















  


**How We Get Things Done…**









 This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at
 

















 www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/
 

















 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.
 








**Championing Inclusion at WBD**



 Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.
 









 If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our
 
 accessibility page
 
 for instructions to submit your request.

47a2fbe7.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
47a2fbe7.description:
Saviynt's AI\-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non\-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit 
 

 www.saviynt.com
 

 .
 




  





 As the Senior Technical Program Manager(IC), you will be a hands\-on leader responsible for setting the technical program direction for a significant product or business area. You will be expected to be technically proficient, capable of managing and mentoring a cross\-disciplinary team to successfully plan, design, and deliver impactful, large\-scale products and services within your domain.
 




  




**WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING** 

  
 


  


 ● Program Portfolio Management: Own the definition, roadmap, and execution of a portfolio of complex technical programs, ensuring alignment across Product and Engineering organizations to meet defined business objectives.
 


  


 ● Refine Collaboration Models: Implement and refine cross\-functional development and delivery frameworks to accelerate the introduction of new technology from conception through deployment within your product domain.
 


  


 ● Execution Leadership: Lead the planning and execution of programs across distributed teams, ensuring the synchronized delivery of software, services, and infrastructure components essential for major product milestones.
 


  


 ● Stakeholder Communication \& Risk Management: Establish and lead regular communication cadence for key stakeholders, providing clear status updates on program health, managing strategic risks, and escalating change control decisions to senior leadership when necessary.
 


  


 ● Technical Partnership: Partner with Engineering Managers and Architects to provide
 


  


 technical oversight and guidance for key development initiatives, contributing to solution definition and mitigation of technical debt within your product area.
 


  


 ● Operational Standards: Maintain and enforce organizational governance standards within your domain, providing visibility and metrics on program health and ensuring accountability for Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
 


  


 ● Domain Process Improvement: Drive and implement targeted process improvements across the product development lifecycle and team structures to address common issues and enhance the efficiency and scalability of the engineering organization within your scope.
 



  




**WHAT YOU BRING** 

 ● Advanced Education: Bachelor’s degree or advanced technical degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering).
 


  


 ● Significant Program Management Experience: 10\-12 years of progressive experience in technical program/project management, with a minimum of 1\-2 years in a Sr TPM or
 


  


 equivalent leadership role (e.g., Group TPM Lead).
 


  


 ● Program Expertise: Solid understanding of the agile software development lifecycle (SDLC) and proven experience in driving large\-scale release and go\-to\-market schedules for a product portfolio.
 


  


 ● Executive Communication: Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical strategies to both technical and non\-technical senior leaders and run program review meetings.
 






  




  


**If required for this role, you will:** 




 \- Complete security \& privacy literacy and awareness training during onboarding and annually thereafter
 



 \- Review (initially and annually thereafter), understand, and adhere to Information Security/Privacy Policies and Procedures such as (but not limited to):
 



  





 \> Data Classification, Retention \& Handling Policy
 



 \> Incident Response Policy/Procedures
 



 \> Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery Policy/Procedures
 



 \> Mobile Device Policy
 



 \> Account Management Policy
 



 \> Access Control Policy
 



 \> Personnel Security Policy
 



 \> Privacy Policy

You will experience tremendous growth and learning opportunities through challenging yet rewarding work which directly impacts our customers, all within a welcoming and positive work environment. 5978ba09.title: Senior Solutions Engineer

**Who are we?**
 Checkmarx is the AI\-powered application security leader helping the world’s most security\- conscious enterprises secure the software that powers modern life. For more than two decades, our unified platform and services have helped organizations protect human\- and AI\- generated code from the first line through runtime, reducing risk across applications, cloud, and the software supply chain without slowing innovation.
   

  

 We’re trusted by 1,600\+ customers in 70\+ countries, including some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world. Guided by research\-led innovation and a developer\-first mindset, we help every developer, security team, and enterprise build software that is risk\-free by design.
   

  

**What are we looking for?**
 Checkmarx is seeking a talented Solutions Engineer to support its sales and business development activities in India and the other local regions. The primary responsibility is to act as a technical adviser and product expert, working with the Sales team and driving the technology evaluation stage in the sales process. You must be able to articulate technology and product positioning to both business and technically\-oriented prospects as well as ensure customer satisfaction throughout the sales cycle. You need to be self\-motivated and work in a fast\-paced environment comfortably. The role involves working remotely and onsite within India, and in additional territory as we expand.
   

  

**How will you make an impact?**
* Act as a technical adviser and product expert for Checkmarx prospects and customers across the region
* Manage and coordinate all technical requirements in the Sales process
* Perform technical demonstrations of the Checkmarx solution in a face to face meetings, conventions, and web sessions
* Responsible for presenting the Checkmarx solution to prospects at field events, Conferences, seminars, etc.
* Able to respond to functional and technical elements of RFPs
* Able to convey customer requirements to the Product Management teams
* Design implementation of solutions according to customer’s technical requirements


 Requirements:
   

  

**What is needed to succeed?**
* A passion to learn and grow in a fast\-changing industry
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or any correlating degree; master’s degree and/or CISSP certification preferred.
* At least 6\+ years’ experience
* Preference for experience with application/software development C\#, .NET, JAVA, PHP, etc. programming languages and experience with modern CI/CD and DevOps tools preferred.
* Experience in a customer\-facing role and enterprise software Pre\-Sales experience or consulting background is preferred.
* Project management experience would be an advantage.
* Technical writing experience a plus.
* Good teamwork capability, ability to work autonomously, self\-starter who works effectively with technical and non\-technical people.
* A background in the software security industry, including penetration testing and code review, is highly preferred.
* Adaptable and flexible with a history of embracing new tools and technologies.
* Understanding of application security challenges and testing tools.
* Travel required when the situation allows and when it is safe to do so.


 What we have to offer:
   

  

 Checkmarx offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, competitive compensation, great work\-life balance, as well as great benefits and perks throughout the year. Checkmarx is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.

0f9a414b.title: Solution Area Specialists Windows & Devices
0f9a414b.description:
**Overview**
 With a vision to
 **build and sell Microsoft AI‑powered platforms, cloud services, and devices through a rich partner ecosystem** 
 , the
 **Windows and Device Sales (WDS)** 
 organization brings together sales, technical expertise, and partners to help customers achieve real business outcomes with Microsoft technology.
   

  

 WDS plays a critical role in shaping and delivering the endpoint platform that powers modern, secure, and AI‑enabled work. WDS works across Microsoft’s commercial ecosystem, including OEMs, silicon partners, distributors, resellers, and services partners \- to drive Windows platform adoption, protect and grow share, and ensure customers realize long‑term value from their device and endpoint investments.
   

  

 This role contributes to a
 **multi‑billion‑dollar business** 
 and plays a direct role in
 **defending and expanding Windows as the enterprise endpoint platform** 
 , enabling customers to modernize their environments, adopt AI‑driven workflows, and build confidence in Windows as the foundation for future innovation.
   

  

 As a Windows Specialist, you will defend and grow Windows within Microsoft’s largest and most strategic customers. You will help them define and modernize their endpoint strategy in an era shaped by AI, security threats, and rapid platform competition. You will operate as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business leaders \- anchoring engagement with the CIO while expanding influence across CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders \- to ensure Windows remains the foundational platform for secure, AI‑driven work.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead high‑impact, time‑bound customer engagements where Windows platform decisions are at risk or strategically critical. You will articulate differentiated Windows value across security, resiliency, management, and AI workloads; orchestrate partners and internal teams to deliver proof and outcomes; and convert lighthouse wins into repeatable evidence that scales across industries and partners.
   

  

 This opportunity will allow you to deepen executive‑level consultative skills, build technical and platform credibility across the Windows ecosystem, and play a visible role in protecting and expanding Microsoft’s commercial footprint in priority accounts.
   

  

 \[
 *This role is flexible in that you can work partially from home* 
 ]
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead Windows endpoint strategy with senior executives: Leverage you technical expertise to lead strategic Windows discussions with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs and AI leaders, translating technology capabilities into business value.
* Defend and extend Windows in competitive environments, deepen insights on why customers adopt alternative platforms, articulate fact based \& differentiated platform value to protect the Windows socket.
* Modernize endpoint management and identity architectures, helping customers decouple from legacy environments, improve total cost of ownership, and unlock AI‑driven workflows at scale.
* Lead high‑impact customer engagements across discovery, envisioning, proof, and value realization, with clear entry criteria, success measures, and exit plans.
* Deliver lighthouse wins that demonstrate real Windows AI value, converting customer outcomes into evidence such as case studies, reference architectures, and repeatable industry scenarios.
* Orchestrate across internal teams and partners, working closely with account teams, engineering, and OEM/channel partners to ensure clarity of roles, clear hand\-offs, escalation process, and accelerated outcomes.
* Provide structured feedback and insights from customer engagements to inform product, go‑to‑market, and partner strategy, identifying patterns that can scale across similar customers.


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications (RQs)**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field AND 8\+ years of customer‑facing experience in enterprise technology, consultative selling, Specialist, solution architecture, or transformation‑focused roles OR
* Equivalent professional experience.
* Demonstrated capability and experience in leading technical and executive‑level customer conversations, translating complex platform concepts into clear, outcome‑oriented guidance for CIO, CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders.
* Prior background in technical sales, solutions architecture, GBB or platform Specialist roles, where credibility across both business outcomes and technical depth was required.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Security and compliance technologies, including Microsoft Defender, Entra, Purview, identity and access management, and Zero Trust principles, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value and risk reduction outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications (PQs)**
* Strong Windows platform expertise, including Windows Pro and Windows 11 Enterprise, with the ability to articulate differentiated value across security, manageability, performance, and AI for enterprise and commercial customers.
* Experience advising customers on Windows 11 lifecycle strategy, including hardware refresh planning, security posture improvements, and operational readiness.
* Proven experience of modern endpoint management and workplace transformation strategies with expertise in Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager and cloud\-native management. Able to advise senior leaders on device management modernization, security, operational efficiency and AI readiness, guiding customers through strategic platform decisions and transformation roadmaps.
* Strong understanding of AI\-ready Windows devices, including Copilot\+ PCs, NPUs and specialized AI silicon. Able to translate platform and hardware innovation into measurable business outcomes, productivity gains and competitive advantage for customers evaluating next\-generation endpoint strategies.


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
 **requesting accommodations.**

As a next\-generation technology leader, Eviden offers a unique combination of hardware and software technologies for businesses, public sector and defense organizations and research institutions, helping them to create value out of their data. Bringing together more than 4,500 world\-class talents and holding more than 2,100 patents, Eviden provides a strong portfolio of innovative and eco\-efficient solutions in AI, computing, security, data and applications.
   

  

 We are looking for Presales Consultant, please find the JD below
   

  

**Presales Consultant**
**Type of Hire** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Min** 
 12\+ yrs
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Presales expert TM – Presales \& Execution plays a pivotal role in the end\-to\-end deal lifecycle, with a primary focus on the presales phase of large, complex IT outsourcing opportunities ranging from £10M to £200M\+ TCV. Acting as the transition solution owner during bids, this role is responsible for designing, validating, and costing transition and transformation programs that are commercially sound, operationally feasible, and aligned with client\-specific requirements.
   

  

 As part of the presales team, the Senior Transition Manager leads transition solutioning and potential due diligence efforts, defines transition strategies, and ensures seamless alignment between solution design and delivery capability. This individual works collaboratively with sales, solution architects, and delivery teams to create robust, end\-to\-end solutions that ensure cost control, risk mitigation, and high\-quality service readiness.
   

  

 In the execution phase, the role ensures the smooth handover of transition plans to delivery teams, supporting early\-stage execution through structured governance, knowledge transfer, and oversight to protect solution integrity and client outcomes.
   

  

* Presales Responsibilities (Primary Focus – 70%)
* Lead the transition solution stream in RFPs, RFIs, and proactive proposals by engaging early with the Sales and Solutioning teams.
* Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders (Sales, Solution Managers, Delivery / Practice Heads, Finance, HR, Legal) to define/validate a transition approach that supports the proposed operating model.
* Develop detailed transition blueprints, high\-level / detailed project plans, staffing models, timelines, risk registers, and assumptions aligned with customer requirements.
* Participate in customer due diligence activities, validating current state operations, capturing transition\-specific constraints, and identifying transformation levers.
* Own and prepare the transition cost model, ensuring alignment with delivery feasibility, internal benchmarks, and bid financial targets.
* Present and defend the transition solution during orals, client presentations, and contract negotiations, articulating the value, approach, risk mitigations, and success criteria.
* Evaluate the readiness of delivery units to execute the proposed transition and identify capability gaps or dependencies.
* Act as a key interface to Delivery Assurance and Risk \& Compliance teams to ensure adherence to Atos governance, legal, and risk management standards.
* Coordinate with the Bid Manager to ensure solution compliance with Atos presales processes (Win2Deliver, RAINBOW etc) while aligning to the Solution to win benchmarks.
* Drive integration of transition and transformation elements into a comprehensive delivery program, ensuring traceability from solution to execution.
* Validate and challenge transformation components (where applicable) to ensure scope, complexity, and dependencies are accurately reflected.
* Support creation of transition\-specific bid artefacts solution write\-ups, SOW inputs, RAID log, governance model, service readiness criteria, and delivery ramp\-up plans.
* Transition Execution Responsibilities (Secondary Focus – 30%)
* Translate bid commitments into execution\-ready transition project plans with aligned workstreams, deliverables, and milestones.
* Ensure smooth handover from presales to delivery by onboarding Transition Project Managers and briefing delivery leads on assumptions, dependencies, and risks.
* Provide ongoing advisory and oversight during initial stages of transition to ensure alignment with bid intent.
* Escalate any deviations or delivery risks identified post\-handover and ensure appropriate mitigation actions are taken.
* Support transition execution governance, helping define escalation paths, program dashboards, and client reporting formats.


**Experience**
* Overall 12\-20 years of experience working in IT service organization
* Should have at least one project management certification (PgMP/PMP/Prince 2 Practitioner/MSP)
* 8\-10 years of experience in Transition management functions within IT or Outsourcing
* Strong client\-facing and management Skills
* Proven track record in an international environment or projects
* Domain expertise is a big plus (Manufacturing, Healthcare, Telecom)


**Key Skills**
* Strong communication and stakeholder management at senior leadership and client executive levels.
* Commercial and financial acumen with ability to balance delivery feasibility and bid competitiveness.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical thinking, and solution structuring abilities.
* Ability to work across geographies and collaborate with diverse, matrixed teams.


**Technical Skills**
* Educated to university level (e.g. Bachelor or Master). Preferably engineering degree in Computer Science/Information systems or related field, plus 7 \+ years directly related experience in IT Infrastructure/Application technical program leadership, as well as in solution development and delivery.
* Minimum of 3 years working in a large international services and IT service support organization on transitioning large contracts.
* Experience in Application Lifecycle, Agile Processes \& Methodologies, IT Infra support (Digital Workplace, Data centre technologies, etc.)
* Strong complex solution lead experience dealing with internal Delivery
* Demonstrated ability to work with large multi–regional cross technology work streams.
* Comfortable working with all levels of a business or IT organization.
* Transitioning enterprise\-wide services from legacy solutions to virtual and cloud\-based solution.


**Leadership Skills**
* Provides guidance and direction to execute project reviews and evaluation with senior stakeholders.
* Leads large (10\-50 staff), geographically dispersed, multi\-cultural, multi\-disciplined project teams, including more than one sub\-contractor in a consortium scenario, and where the solution/ technology is immature and/or leading edge.
* Actively coaches others. Creates team spirit and a supportive environment.
* Acts as role model.


**Project Organization**
* Plans and controls very complex portfolios of projects.
* Defines risk strategies, approaches and tools. Identifies and manages risks, issues and assumptions on portfolio of complex projects.
* Influences senior stakeholders to apply and/or adapt Atos standards to the project to maximize effectiveness.
* Manages handover including proposal for reallocation of staff and disposal of assets not included in handover.
* Promotes continuous improvement.


**Delivery Management**
* Efficiently engages with senior stakeholders to agree/influence strategy, directing complex projects and maximizing benefits.
* Defines project requirements/scope with senior stakeholders maximizing Atos’s commercial position and client value.
* Maintains a view on the bigger picture.
* Able to judge complex risk analysis and translate to possible solutions. Has a clear vision on factors that influence strategic decision making, initiating/driving development of innovative products and services.
* Maximizes effectiveness while achieving standards, ensuring control of deliverables.


**Relationship Management**
* Builds relationships with customers based on mutual trust and respect. Monitors performance targets and deadlines in addition to quality standards. Tailors Atos products to best\-fit customer needs.
* Demonstrates strong consistency between communication and action. Is sought out for advice and solutions. Recognises potential areas of conflict and leads resolution.
* Promotes cross\-functional team working. Ensures that common goals are understood.
* Communicates complex information. Commands attention and can manage large groups. Actively engages and manages stakeholder community.


**Commercial Drive**
* Produces budgets and identifies controls to maintain a profitable environment. Identifies and pursues opportunities to create added value for the client and Atos.
* Leads an effective overall change control and approval by Change Control Board, updates and coordinates the project plan. Can propose and implement changes with senior stakeholders.
* Leads projects with respect to revenue and margin, team size, geographical spread, sub\-contractor terms, risk profile and diverse technologies.
* Leads excellent client relationship balanced with the Atos commercial position, utilizing strategic negotiations where appropriate.

2ef05ee3.title: Architect
2ef05ee3.description:
**Job Summary**
 Design and evolve robust distributed systems as an Architect with deep expertise in Kafka AWS and modern Java including Springboot Java 21 Java 11 Core and Advanced Java operating in a hybrid day shift environment. Drive scalable event driven architectures and cloud native solutions that enhance business agility improve reliability and support sustainable growth for a global enterprise.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design scalable event driven architectures using Kafka that support high volume data streams and ensure resilient communication between critical microservices in complex enterprise ecosystems.
* Architect cloud native solutions on AWS that optimize cost performance and security while aligning with organizational standards and long term technology roadmaps.
* Define and maintain application architecture patterns using Java Springboot and modern Java versions to ensure consistency reliability and ease of maintenance across distributed systems.
* Develop reference implementations and reusable components in Core Java and Advanced Java that accelerate delivery and promote standardization across multiple product teams.
* Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into clear architectural blueprints and technical designs that deliver measurable outcomes.
* Review solution designs and code implementations to verify adherence to architecture principles performance targets and security guidelines across Kafka AWS and Java services.
* Provide hands on guidance to engineering teams on best practices for Kafka topics partitions consumer groups and streaming patterns to enhance throughput and fault tolerance.
* Optimize AWS infrastructure including compute storage and networking configurations to achieve high availability observability and efficient resource utilization for all solutions.
* Analyze system performance metrics and production incidents to identify architectural improvements that reduce latency improve stability and strengthen overall platform resilience.
* Document architecture decisions integration patterns and technology standards in a clear and accessible manner to support knowledge sharing and long term maintainability.
* Engage in hybrid collaboration routines including on site design workshops and remote reviews to ensure architectural alignment across geographically distributed teams.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security and governance requirements by embedding secure coding practices and robust access controls into all Kafka AWS and Java based designs.
* Drive continuous improvement by assessing emerging features in Java 21 and Springboot and proposing targeted adoption strategies that deliver tangible business value.


**Qualifications**
* Bring extensive practical experience in Kafka including designing topics configuring clusters and managing streaming pipelines for mission critical applications.
* Demonstrate strong proficiency in AWS services relevant to distributed architectures such as compute storage networking and managed databases with a focus on reliability and cost efficiency.
* Exhibit advanced skills in Java Springboot and modern Java versions including Java 21 and Java 11 with a proven ability to build secure performant backend services.
* Show deep understanding of Core Java and Advanced Java concepts including concurrency collections and memory management applied to large scale enterprise systems.
* Apply solid knowledge of microservices architecture integration patterns and API design to build modular extensible and easily testable solutions.
* Utilize strong experience in hybrid work models to collaborate effectively across remote and on site settings while maintaining high communication standards and delivery quality.
* Leverage excellent problem solving and analytical abilities to diagnose complex system issues and propose practical architectural enhancements that align with business priorities.


**Certifications Required**
 Preferred certifications include AWS Certified Solutions Architect and Confluent Certified Developer for Apache Kafka or equivalent cloud and streaming credentials.

2568b7b1.title: Senior Specialist, Solution Architecture
2568b7b1.description:
**Job Description**
 Senior Specialist, Solution Architecture
   

  

**The Opportunity**
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company's’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 An imperative around driving efficient, scalable, reusable, and easy to consume technology solutions is a bedrock of our Digital Strategy. The focus of this role is to “provide strategic technology decisions linked to investments that achieve business outcomes”. This role will set the direction and focus for the architecture capability that will underpin both our Manufacturing Division and the wider company’s Digital Strategy.
   

  

 This position will support architecture guidance and governance for our Manufacturing Division, in support of the key capabilities in our global manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and operations value teams. The position, in partnership with the Enterprise Architecture team, is responsible for delivering business, systems, information and technology architecture artifacts that drive investments for our Manufacturing Division. This role will work collaboratively with business and IT leaders throughout our company.
   

  

**What Will You Do In This Role**
* Collaborate with peer architects to deliver value\-centric designs to support Manufacturing Division demands.
* Create documented architectures in collaboration with the Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain Value teams.
* Advise value teams on modern information architecture practices for system integration iPass, (Application Integration as a Service), Data Abstraction Layers, APIs, ect.
* Provide operational input into architectures for the various value teams to ensure plan and predictable performance for site based and enterprise applications / products within our Manufacturing Division.
* Participate in the architecture community for our Manufacturing Division, gaining alignment of architecture practices and capabilities for the division, in alignment with Enterprise Architecture (EA) practices.
* Update and maintain the Manufacturing Standard Architecture (MSA) and Enterprise Capability Model.
* Support the collection / assessment of metrics of technology maturity, health, and business value and plays an active role in delivering the MSA.
* Partnering with the EA Systems Architect team, re\-use the best available technologies and processes from across the enterprise.
* Lead the creation of a common and well managed set of Architecture practices, which includes architecture models, architecture methods and templates, architecture communities and training, and much more.
* Stay current with industry technology trends, cross industry architecture standards and introduce best practices to our Manufacturing Division. Ensure our company takes an active role in developing and sustaining the relevant industry standards.
* Effectively work with both waterfall and agile project teams to evolve the technical landscape toward the desired end state.
* Prepare and deliver executive level briefings and communicate complex topics effectively to diverse audiences.
* The ability to travel will be required Domestic and International (\~10%)


**What Should You Have**
* Education Minimum Requirement Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related study other.
* Required Experience and Skills
* 5\+ years in a business architecture, information architecture, or system architecture role
* Deep experience supporting at least one of the following areas Manufacturing, Quality Labs, Supply Chain, or Manufacturing Site Operations
* Experience documenting business processes and understanding how they align with technology topologies and architectures
* Results\-orientation with the proven ability and reputation for developing plans and implementing them successfully
* Proven skill in partnering with stakeholders and navigate across conflicting priorities to balance critical tactical and strategic needs
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills – able to effectively communicate complex concepts in simple ways
* Demonstrated ability to effectively collaborate and communicate with a variety of audiences and stakeholders


**Primary Skills**
* Prior experience in the pharmaceutical industry
* Experience in integrating real time shopfloor and lab systems, at an enterprise level, with appropriate levels of resiliency and performance, using modern information architecture practices for system integration (iPaSS and Data Abstraction Layers)
* Cloud technology architecture experience
* Exposure to multiple, diverse technologies and processing environments.
* Experience in developing Process and Master Data Management strategies
* Experience in manufacturing analytics systems, supply and demand forecasting, biologics process modelling, and advanced image analysis
* Understanding of regulatory requirements that drive IT and OT delivery, including 21\-CFR\-Part\-11, Annex 11, Good Manufacturing practices, Computer Systems Validation, track and trace, and other global regulatory requirements that impact IT and OT systems in the manufacturing and supply chain space
* Understanding of Information and Operations Technology (IT/OT) systems that support Manufacturing \& Supply Chains, including manufacturing execution systems, quality \& labs systems, resource planning systems, MES and Process Control technologies, track \& trace, cold chain and other supply chain systems, OT security and shop floor networks
* Working knowledge and application of Perdue Model, ISA S95 and S88 Standards in GxP environment
* Experience in Enterprise Architecture
* Experience implementing TOGAF framework.


**Who We Are**
 We are known as well\-known org Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
   

  

**What We Look For**
 Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 Data Modeling, Design Applications, Digital Strategy, Enterprise Architecture (EA), Enterprise Architecture Management, Executive Briefing, Global Manufacturing, Information Architectures, Manufacturing Analytics, Manufacturing Support, Master Data Management (MDM), Oral Communications, Regulatory Requirements, Release Management, Requirements Management, Solution Architecture, System Designs, System Integration, Technology Trends

66d0bc37.title: Software Engineering Architect
66d0bc37.description:
Meet the Team
  
  

Our team is at the forefront of engineering excellence, dedicated to advancing Cisco’s mission\-critical Vulnerability Scanning and Attack Surface Management platforms. We operate at the intersection of innovation and security, building robust, scalable solutions that drive the stability and evolution of our enterprise infrastructure.
  
  

By joining us, you will collaborate with a high\-performing, cross\-functional team committed to solving complex technical challenges and delivering impactful software that secures and optimizes our technology ecosystem.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineering Architect to lead the design, implementation, and operation of scalable software solutions and automation workflows. This role combines hands\-on development, solution architecture, infrastructure planning, production ownership, and technical leadership.
  
  

The ideal candidate has strong experience with Golang and Python, along with practical knowledge of vulnerability\-scanning tools and security automation.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead requirement\-gathering sessions with stakeholders and translate business needs into clearly defined technical scope and deliverables.
* Create system and feature architecture, including both high\-level and low\-level designs.
* Evaluate technical options and make architecture decisions based on scalability, security, reliability, maintainability, and operational cost.
* Design and implement production\-quality software solutions using Golang, Python, and related technologies.
* Develop automation workflows that integrate with vulnerability\-scanning tools, APIs, data sources, and operational systems.
* Define API contracts, data models, integration patterns, and reusable software components.
* Provide technical direction, design reviews, code reviews, and hands\-on guidance to engineering teams.
* Establish development standards and promote secure coding, automated testing, observability, and maintainable engineering practices.
* Develop infrastructure and application deployment strategies across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
* Collaborate with platform, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to support reliable releases.
* Own or support production operations, including monitoring, incident response, troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Provide Tier\-2 support for complex application, integration, automation, and production issues.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement automation to improve efficiency, reliability, and response time.
* Produce and maintain architecture diagrams, technical specifications, runbooks, deployment documentation, and support procedures.
* Mentor engineers and help improve the team’s technical capabilities.


Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant experience in software engineering, with experience serving as a software architect, technical lead, or principal engineer.
* Strong hands\-on programming experience with Golang.
* Strong hands\-on programming experience with Python.
* Experience designing distributed, service\-oriented, API\-driven, or event\-driven systems.
* Experience producing high\-level and low\-level technical designs.
* Experience developing automation workflows for vulnerability\-scanning or security\-management tools.

* Experience defining infrastructure deployment strategies using containers, cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, or infrastructure\-as\-code practices.

* Understanding of secure software development, logging, monitoring, alerting, testing, and reliability practices.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical decisions to engineering and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience integrating platforms such as Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, or comparable vulnerability\-management tools.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with message queues, workflow engines, relational databases, and NoSQL technologies.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and security controls throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Experience designing highly available and fault\-tolerant systems.
* Experience leading technical initiatives across multiple teams.
* Familiarity with service\-level objectives, incident management, and operational readiness reviews.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

* Build reusable agent patterns for banking operations use cases (e.g., case resolution, reconciliation, compliance checks).
* **4\). LLM \& GenAI Expertise (Hands\-on Execution) ·**
* Hands\-on experience with LLM platforms including: • Claude (Anthropic) • Gemini (Google) • GPT (OpenAI) ·
* Design prompt architectures, reasoning chains, and agent workflows. · Implement RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) and contextual grounding strategies. ·
* Evaluate model performance, reliability, and enterprise readiness. ·
* Ensure responsible AI usage, governance, and compliance adherence.
* **5\) Capability Development: Agentic Skills Library \& Reusable Assets** ·
* Build and maintain an Agentic Skills Library of reusable capabilities, including: Task\-specific AI agents (e.g., summarization, reconciliation, classification, decision support). • Workflow components (e.g., data extraction, validation, routing, reasoning chains). • Prompt templates, tool\-use patterns, and orchestration blueprints. ·
* Enable systematic reuse of agentic capabilities across multiple banking use cases. ·
* Establish standards for versioning, governance, and lifecycle management of agent skills. ·
* Continuously expand the library based on production learnings and new use cases.
* Drive “build once, reuse everywhere” approach for agentic automation.

* **Required Qualifications:**
* Overall 18\+ of industry experience with 7\+ years of Artificial Intelligence Solutions experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

 **Required Qualifications for Europe, Middle East \& Africa only:**

* Digital product management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, education

 **Desired Qualifications:**

* Production‑Grade LLM Agent Deployment: Proven experience designing, deploying, and operating LLM‑driven agentic systems in production, with attention to reliability, safety, evaluation, and governance in enterprise environments.
* Deep LLM Platform Expertise: Hands‑on mastery of modern LLMs (GPT‑4/4\.1, Claude, Gemini, or equivalents), including model selection, prompt‑to‑model matching, latency/cost optimization, and comparative evaluation.
* LLM Reasoning \& Prompt Engineering: Advanced capability in prompt engineering, structured reasoning, chain‑of‑thought management, constrained generation, and output validation for real‑world workflows.
* Agentic LLM Architecture \& Orchestration: Strong understanding of LLM‑based agent architectures, including tool calling, function schemas, multi‑agent coordination, planning loops, memory strategies, and guardrails.
* RAG, Context Injection \& Knowledge Integration: Practical experience implementing RAG pipelines, embeddings, retrieval strategies, document chunking, re‑ranking, and contextual grounding to reliably augment LLM outputs.
* LLM‑to‑Enterprise Integration: Experience integrating LLM agents with enterprise systems using Python (APIs, databases, SaaS tools, internal services) via MCP or comparable LLM‑integration frameworks.
* Python‑Based Agentic Systems Engineering: Advanced Python proficiency for building production‑grade agentic systems including planning loops, state management, async execution, and modular service design.
* Customer‑Facing LLM Solution Ownership: Ability to work directly with customers and senior stakeholders to translate business processes into LLM‑powered agentic solutions, define success metrics, and deliver measurable impact.

**Description**
 Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
   

  

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi\-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.
   

  

 You will take end\-to\-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi\-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.
   

  

 Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best\-practices are applied, including: (1\) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2\) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3\) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.
   

  

 In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy\-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non\-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on\-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

22d84b87.title: Lead Cybersecurity Architect
22d84b87.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Join a team where your expertise in cybersecurity architecture shapes the future of secure technology solutions. Grow your career by collaborating with top engineering, product, and business professionals.


As a Lead Cybersecurity Architect at JPMorgan Chase within the Cybersecurity and Technology Controls team, you will design and deliver high\-quality cybersecurity solutions for software applications and platform products. You will partner with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions are secure by design, resilient, and aligned to regulatory and audit expectations. You will play a key role in supporting Chase UK and JPMorgan Personal Investing, contributing to a collaborative and innovative team culture. You will help drive impactful outcomes for the firm and its clients.

**Job responsibilities**

* Perform secure design reviews and threat modeling with application teams to ensure products are secure by design.
* Demonstrate deep understanding of product strategy, roadmap, and key investment programs.
* Identify and learn unfamiliar technology components, capabilities, and business concepts, applying critical thinking to uncover hidden issues.
* Leverages enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate cybersecurity architecture analysis and decisioning (e.g., risk identification and documentation), validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity and security requirements.
* Drives reuse\-first adoption of AI\-assisted security validation within SDLC/toolchain routines, improving control testing and remediation quality with traceability/auditability and resiliency expectations.
* Share best practices and serve as the point of escalation and subject matter expert for Cybersecurity and Technology Controls.
* Collaborate with product, technology, and business colleagues for audit, regulatory, risk, and project initiatives.
* Work with Third Party Oversight teams to manage technology risk for vendors, focusing on cloud computing and emerging technologies.

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Formal training or certification on security engineering concepts and 5\+ years applied experience
* Advanced knowledge of cybersecurity architecture, applications, and technical processes with expertise in one or more technical disciplines
* Ability to design and implement effective cybersecurity and technology controls
* Strong knowledge of security best practices and DevSecOps methodologies
* Experience with cloud security posture management and vulnerability management
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support cybersecurity architecture workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to assess and validate AI\-assisted security recommendations before adoption, escalating uncertainty and ensuring outcomes align to security, resiliency, and auditability expectations.
* Understanding of network security, network design, segmentation, firewalls, and cloud networking patterns
* Experience implementing and reviewing authentication and authorization controls and best practices
* Hands\-on experience in software development with strong understanding of SDLC and secure SDLC practices
* Knowledge of modern application architectures including microservices, APIs, and event\-driven patterns

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Experience with identity federation, least privilege, RBAC/ABAC concepts
* Experience with cloud security technologies and emerging security trends
* Ability to influence and partner across product supply chains
* Experience working with Third Party Oversight teams and managing vendor technology risk


**ABOUT US**

1689b377.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
1689b377.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


**Introduction to the Team:**  

InsurTech is Expedia Group’s team for **insurance and assurance products** . It identifies, incubates, and scales products that drive revenue and fit into the traveler journey, and it owns the end\-to\-end technology strategy and execution for those products.
  

In practice, the team builds reusable shop/book/serve capabilities for insurance and fintech offerings across Expedia brands, and focuses on things like supply integration, checkout, servicing, claims, content, experimentation, and ML/data platforms.
  

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead the definition, planning, and delivery of complex, multi\-team technical programs across the Insurtech organization, with a focus on Insurance and embedded flexibility products, ensuring clear problem framing, measurable outcomes, and alignment to Expedia Group’s strategic objectives.
* Drive innovative programs that improve the traveler experience while delivering significant impact to a P\&L business within Expedia Group, translating strategy into executable roadmaps, operating plans, and measurable business and customer outcomes.
* Drive end\-to\-end program execution by establishing program structures, roadmaps, and success metrics; proactively identifying cross\-team dependencies; and resolving risks and issues to maintain predictable delivery across engineering, product, business, and partner stakeholders.
* Partner closely with engineering and architecture leaders to shape technical solutions, including system design, API contracts, and data flows, and ensure design decisions support scalability, resilience, security, and long\-term maintainability.
* Collaborate with supplier partners and cross\-functional teams across global markets to deliver customer and commercial value at scale, align priorities, and accelerate execution across a distributed ecosystem.
* Create and operate effective governance and communication mechanisms, including steering forums, technical reviews, and decision logs, that provide transparency, enable timely trade\-offs, and keep executives, partner organizations, and stakeholders informed and engaged.
* Drive breakthrough and 0\-to\-1 product development outcomes by enabling experimentation, validating new opportunities, and helping teams turn emerging concepts into scalable products and platform capabilities.
* Champion and implement best practices in technical program management at scale, including standardized planning, execution, and operational excellence practices, while mentoring other TPMs and influencing how programs are run across the broader organization.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve outcomes by coordinating experimentation, rollout, and monitoring plans, and ensuring teams have the practices and controls needed to use AI\-driven systems, tools, and workflows responsibly and effectively.

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience leading complex technology initiatives.
* Extensive experience (typically 10\+ years) in technical program management, software engineering, or a closely related discipline, including ownership of large, cross\-team, or multi\-service programs in a technology organization.
* Proven ability to work hands\-on with engineering teams on technical topics such as distributed system design, API design, data modeling, and integration patterns, and to translate technical details into clear, outcome\-focused plans.
* Demonstrated success driving programs from concept through launch and ongoing iteration, including definition of measurable objectives, risk and dependency management, and establishing mechanisms for tracking and reporting progress at scale.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including partnering with engineering and data teams to ensure such capabilities are integrated and operated safely and effectively within program scope.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Track record of leading multi\-quarter, multi\-team technical transformations, platform initiatives, or 0\-to\-1 product programs, operating at organization or domain scale and navigating complex stakeholder landscapes across product, engineering, and business teams.
* Experience delivering in highly regulated product environments, with the ability to incorporate compliance, risk, privacy, security, and operational control requirements into program planning, execution, and decision\-making.
* Strong experience with B2C program and product development, including delivering customer\-facing capabilities that improve user experience, drive adoption, and balance customer value with measurable business outcomes.
* Deep experience influencing technical direction through program work, including coordinating architectural reviews, driving alignment on system and API design decisions, and ensuring data models and integration approaches enable long\-term extensibility, reuse, and partner interoperability.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with external partners, suppliers, and third\-party providers, aligning joint roadmaps, managing dependencies, and delivering shared outcomes across internal and external teams.
* Demonstrated ability to design and improve program operating models and execution frameworks, including mechanisms that enhance reliability, observability, incident response, and continuous improvement for large\-scale, customer\-facing systems.
* Strong data\-driven decision\-making skills, including defining and instrumenting key technical and business metrics, using data to assess program health and trade\-offs, and adjusting plans based on empirical evidence, experimentation results, and evolving market or partner inputs.
* Safely integrates and operates AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve outcomes, with experience steering AI/ML\-related programs such as personalization, automation, or decision\-support capabilities, including responsible use guardrails, evaluation methods, and collaboration with specialized AI/ML teams.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.  



  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .  



  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

6d7abe16.title: Sr. Solutions Architect, Amazon Leo for Government
6d7abe16.description:
**Description**
 Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low\-latency, high\-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. The mission of Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) is to enable Leo to provide high speed, low latency, and secure satellite broadband services to United States and allied government customers.
   

  

**The Role**
 We have an immediate opening for a Sr Solutions Architect to support the Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) team focusing on ANZ Government customers. This position will be part of the ALG team working with Business Development and customers to define Leo Government family of products within Leo’s broadband space network for high throughput, low latency broadband communications. This is a unique opportunity to innovate and define communications technology with few legacy constraints. The team develops and designs the Leo Government products and analyzes performance such as for overall throughput, latency, and system availability. This team also works closely with customers, business development and the engineering team to ensure that the product will meet customer requirements and presents a good business opportunity for Amazon Leo for Government.
   

  

 This position may require access to information, technology, or hardware that is subject to export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Employment in this position is contingent upon obtaining any required export licenses or other approvals from the United States government. As such, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain any necessary export licenses or approvals based on their nationality, citizenship, and any other factors considered by the applicable export control regulations
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Work with business development and customers to help understand and refine their use cases and operational problems to solve
* Work with Engineering to invent new products or product features
* Write product roadmaps, product description documents, and engineering requirements documents for products and product families
* Create detailed product requirements documents based on an intimate knowledge of the specific customer verticals (local, state, federal, DoD, intelligence community) including use case prioritization, feature definition and product roadmap
* Work with leadership team to set the customer strategy and make appropriate high\-judgment trade\-offs between features and speed\-to\-launch
* Research and identify new opportunities to innovate on behalf of our customers
* Anticipate bottlenecks, manage risk and escalations, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints


**Basic Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field
* Space systems, satellite communications, and / or terrestrial networking experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* Experience with presentations and speaking with executives, IT, management, and developers
* Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics).

We pay our respect to their elders past and present and extend that respect to all Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples today.
   

  

**IDE Statement**
 Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
   

  

 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information.
