c5c99cb2.title: Technical Program Manager, Risk
c5c99cb2.description:
Who we are
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Stripe mission is to build the economic infrastructure for the internet. Risk and Compliance Engineering builds products to lower financial and regulatory risk at scale for Stripe, while retaining a best\-in\-class user experience. We build user\-facing products and backend platforms to ensure our users are compliant with regulatory and financial partner requirements. We protect the Stripe brand while also protecting the company from financial losses that can put the Stripe business at risk. The Risk TPM team is crucial to driving programs to address these challenges.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 As a Technical Program Manager in the Risk and Compliance space, you'll play a key role across engineering, product, and strategy to drive programs that span across the Risk organization and Stripe. You'll be responsible for the successful definition, cross\-functional strategy, planning, and execution of large\-scale technical programs that help to solve complex problems and empower Stripe and our users.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Execute on technical programs that require deep systems and engineering knowledge.
* Partner with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and other cross\-functional partners to define, scope, and drive large programs to conclusion.
* Develop, implement, and iterate on program management techniques, frameworks, and key performance indicators to achieve goals with well\-defined success criteria.
* Make substantial improvements to how the teams you work with communicate and operate to significantly increase the productivity and efficiency of the teams.
* Define and produce high\-quality written proposals, communications and documentation.
* Leverage data and acquired knowledge to drive strategic decisions at an engineering leadership level.
* Create widely circulated plans, driving consistency, clarity, and building alignment across teams.


 Who you are
   

  

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements**
* 5\+ years of software engineering, systems engineering, or technical program management experience.
* You have excellent analytical skills, digest complex information, and make recommendations.
* You have a track record of providing program management during all phases of software development from kickoff to launch, demonstrating critical thinking, challenging the norms, and thought leadership.
* You have very strong written and verbal communication skills, building strong relationships with stakeholders, teams, and senior leaders around the organization.
* You drive internal and external process improvements across multiple teams and functions and bring a wealth of experience, opinions, proposals, and best practices.
* Experience operating autonomously and leading large\-scale efforts across multiple teams and functions, with stakeholders in different disciplines across time zones.


**Preferred Qualifications**

221e8be1.title: Solution Architect
221e8be1.description:
**SOLUTION ARCHITECT** **We are looking for a Solution Architect to be part of our Nestlé Nespresso Digital and Tech Team. At Nespresso, our Digital \& Tech teams are at the heart of our innovation journey, a space where we continue to invest, evolve, and grow.** **Position Snapshot:*** Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
* Type of Contract: Permanent
* Grade: Band 2
* Type of work: Hybrid
* Work Language: Fluent Business English

 **The Role:**  

As a **Solutions Architect**, you will work within a team of Enterprise and Solution Architects across the Nespresso Tech landscape. You'll handle multiple projects related to both transformation and business evolution, delivering End\-to\-End Solution Architecture and overseeing its implementation.  

In this role, you will manage the Enterprise and Solution Architecture for Nespresso’s global application landscape, supporting all markets and HQ functions. You will also be part of a team that drives innovation and new features for the business, all while spearheading a digital transformation to enhance competitiveness and speed to the market.  

**In This Role, You Will:**  

* Deliver architectural designs and input to the roadmap, translating business needs into comprehensive technical solutions.
* Facilitate the evaluation and selection of software products and services, and design standard and custom software configurations.
* Implement and integrate solutions, crafting integration strategies for cross\-application purposes.
* Guide the technical architecture implementation across product groups, ensuring alignment with business strategies and requirements.
* Identify organizational and financial impacts of solution architecture.
* Monitor the current\-state solution portfolio to identify technology deficiencies or misalignments with business requirements.

Oversee governance activities to ensure product architecture security, assurance, and compliance.  
* 

**What We’re Looking For:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, systems analysis, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8\+ years of experience in IT solution development disciplines (solution architecture, technical architecture, network management, application development, middleware, database management, or operations).
* Experience in translating future\-state business capabilities and requirements into solution architecture requirements.
* Excellent understanding of application development methodologies and infrastructure/network architecture.
* Ability to estimate the financial impact of solution architecture alternatives.
* Familiarity with diverse technologies and processing environments (REST/SOAP APIs, Event\-driven architectures, micro\-services, cloud, and on\-premises solutions).
* Experience documenting End\-to\-End architectures using UML and/or C4 diagrams.

 **Extra Skills That Set You Apart:**  

* Experience with Confluent Kafka.
* Experience with Mulesoft API Gateway.
* Experience in CommerceTools.
* Experience with Dynamics 365 suite (CRM, Commerce or Customer Service)
* Experience in LeanIX.

 **We Offer You:**  

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.* Flexible work policies including core hours and options for working from home. Discuss with us during the recruitment process to understand what flexibility could look like for you!
* Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
* Modern "smart office" locations providing agile workspaces. Our state\-of\-the\-art campus is equipped with areas to co\-create, network, and chill!
* International, dynamic \& inclusive working environment with attractive additional benefits.
* The pride to work for a B Corp certified company and one of the world’s most trusted brands.

 **The Hiring Process:*** **Your Application:** Submit your application, and we'll review it carefully (make sure your CV is in English as the hiring team is international).
* **Initial Screening:** Relevant candidates will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition team for an initial interview.
* **Hiring Manager Interview:** Selected candidates will then meet with the hiring manager to discuss the role and their experience in more detail.
* **Stakeholder Interview:** Candidates will engage with potential team members to assess fit and collaboration.
* **Leadership \& HRBP Interaction:** Candidates will have a discussion with our leadership team \& HRBP.
* **Feedback:** After interviews, we provide feedback to all candidates.
* **Job Offer:** Successful candidates will receive a formal offer.
* **First Working Day:** Once the offer is accepted, we’ll welcome you on your first day!

 **About Nespresso:**  

The Nespresso story began with a simple but revolutionary idea: enable anyone to create the perfect cup of espresso coffee.  

Since 1986, Nespresso has redefined and revolutionized the way millions of people enjoy their coffee.  

We are a Company committed with the Climate change and we aim to achieve carbon neutrality as soon as possible and net\-zero GHG emissions by 2050 at the latest.
In 2019 we created the digital hub in Barcelona to offer the best customer experience and innovation to B2C and B2B channels.  

*We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.*
People are at the heart of our success – all 14,000 of them. We actively cultivate diversity, inclusion and belonging in the workplace. We celebrate individuality, believing that your authenticity and uniqueness can help us to grow and thrive together
Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.
**Join Nestlé \#beaforceforgood**

4c13fd0a.title: Senior Artificial Intelligence Solutions Consultant
4c13fd0a.description:
**About this Role**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Artificial Intelligence Solutions Consultant to accelerate the adoption and delivery of AI\-enabled business solutions using Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and other low\-code/no\-code AI platforms.


In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and AI leaders to identify opportunities where Generative AI can improve productivity, automate tasks, simplify workflows, and enhance user experiences. You will design, test, and optimize prompts, build AI\-powered solutions and prototypes, and help establish reusable patterns and best practices for AI adoption across the organization.


Initially, the role will focus on prompt engineering, Copilot solution development, experimentation, and rapid prototyping. Over time, the role may expand into broader AI solution design and delivery responsibilities.

**In this role, you will.**

* Lead the design and development of AI\-enabled business solutions using Microsoft 365 Copilot and related AI platforms.
* Partner with business stakeholders to identify high\-value AI use cases and translate business needs into AI\-assisted workflows.
* Design, test, evaluate, and optimize prompts to improve response quality, accuracy, and user experience.
* Develop reusable prompt libraries, templates, and best practices aligned to business capabilities and user journeys.
* Build rapid prototypes and proof\-of\-concepts using low\-code/no\-code AI development tools.
* Support implementation of AI assistants, copilots, knowledge retrieval experiences, and workflow automation solutions.
* Perform AI solution testing, validation, and quality reviews to ensure solutions meet business objectives.
* Document findings, recommendations, and implementation approaches.
* Support AI enablement efforts by demonstrating solutions, training users, and promoting adoption of AI capabilities.
* Collaborate with architects, data partners, technology teams, and business stakeholders to drive successful AI outcomes.

**Required Qualification:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, Business Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 4\+ years of experience delivering technology, automation, analytics, digital transformation, AI, or software solutions.
* Hands\-on experience using Generative AI platforms such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude, Gemini, or similar technologies.
* Experience designing, testing, and refining prompts for business use cases.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to define requirements and translate business needs into technology solutions.
* Experience building prototypes, proofs\-of\-concept, or automation solutions using low\-code/no\-code platforms.
* Understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI concepts, and responsible AI practices.
* Ability to define AI evaluation criteria and assess solution quality and effectiveness.
* Strong communication, facilitation, problem\-solving, and consulting skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, highly collaborative environment.

**Microsoft Copilot \& AI Solutions**

* Microsoft 365 Copilot
* Prompt Engineering
* Conversational AI Design
* Generative AI Fundamentals
* AI Solution Testing and Evaluation
* AI Adoption and Enablement

**Solution Development**

* Low\-Code / No\-Code Development
* Business Process Automation
* API and Connector Integration
* Requirements Analysis
* Rapid Prototyping

**Technical Foundations**

* Basic to Intermediate Python Scripting
* Data Analysis and Manipulation
* REST API Concepts
* JSON and Structured Data Formats

**Desired Qualification:**


The ideal candidate is a business\-focused AI practitioner who can bridge the gap between business needs and AI capabilities. This person is equally comfortable working with stakeholders to define use cases, designing effective prompts, evaluating AI responses, and rapidly prototyping solutions using Copilot and low\-code platforms.


Success in this role requires curiosity, experimentation, strong communication skills, and a passion for helping users unlock value from Generative AI technologies.

* Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio.
* Experience configuring AI agents, actions, connectors, and enterprise knowledge sources.
* Experience building Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
* Understanding of semantic search, vector search, and embeddings.
* Experience with Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
* Experience with Agentic AI concepts and multi\-agent architectures.
* Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or similar frameworks.
* Knowledge of enterprise content management, knowledge bases, and document retrieval solutions.
* Experience working within highly regulated industries such as financial services.

**Job Expectation:**


Provide elastic AI delivery capacity focused on:

* Prompt engineering
* Microsoft 365 Copilot solutions
* Copilot Studio solutions
* AI\-assisted workflow automation
* Business experimentation and rapid prototyping
* AI response evaluation and quality assurance
* AI enablement and user adoption
* As the AI program matures, responsibilities may expand into:
* Advanced AI solution architecture
* Agentic AI solutions
* Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Enterprise AI platforms
* AI governance and operating model support
* End\-to\-end AI product delivery

**Posting End Date:**


23 Aug 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**


Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.


Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.


Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**


To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

  

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**


a. Third\-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.


b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

6aee4d80.title: IT Senior Architect - Linux & Open-Source
6aee4d80.description:
**IT Senior Architect \- Linux \& Open\-Source**

**Role Overview**


We are looking for an experienced IT Architect – Linux \& Open Source Infrastructure to design, evolve and govern our Linux server landscape and the broader open\-source technology stack that underpins our business\-critical applications. You will own the technical architecture end\-to\-end \- from on\-premises data centers to hybrid and cloud environments \- and act as the technical authority for standards, security and scalability across the platform.


Beyond the OS layer, you will shape our open\-source technology strategy: which tools and platforms we standardize on, how we evaluate open source vs. proprietary/commercial options and how we manage the licensing, support and community engagement that come with running open source at enterprise scale.


The IT operations are outsourced to an external service provider. This role is therefore architecture\- and governance\-focused rather than hands\-on operational, with a strong emphasis on steering and collaborating with the outsourcing partner. You will set direction, but you will also get into the weeds of automation, hardening and performance tuning when it matters.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and maintain the target\-state architecture for Linux server and desktop infrastructure (e.g. RHEL/CentOS/Oracle Linux, SUSE, Ubuntu/Debian, as applicable) across on\-prem, virtualized and cloud environments
* Own the architecture and roadmap for the broader open\-source infrastructure stack (automation, orchestration, observability, CI/CD, identity, data platforms)
* Define standards for OS builds, patching, hardening and lifecycle management and ensure compliance across the estate
* Architect and oversee infrastructure automation (configuration management, provisioning, CI/CD for infrastructure) to enable consistent, repeatable deployments
* Lead the evaluation and integration of virtualization and containerization platforms (e.g. oVirt, KVM, Kubernetes/OpenShift)
* Design for high availability, disaster recovery, backup and business continuity of Linux and open\-source\-based systems
* Own capacity planning and performance engineering for the platform
* Define and enforce security architecture in collaboration with Cyber Sec: identity and access management, system hardening (CIS benchmarks), vulnerability and patch management
* Own open\-source license compliance and governance (e.g. tracking OSS licenses in use, ensuring compliant usage, managing support contracts for OSS distributions)
* Act as technical escalation point for complex incidents and problem management
* Produce architecture documentation, design decisions (ADRs) and roadmaps; present these to technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Evaluate new technologies and vendors and provide build\-vs\-buy / open\-source\-vs\-commercial recommendations
* Mentor system administrators and engineers on Linux and open\-source best practices
* Collaborate closely with outsourcing provider, application owner, architects, network/security teams and cloud teams to ensure end\-to\-end architectural coherence

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience
* 7\+ years of experience administering and/or architecting Linux environments, including several years in an architecture or technical lead role
* Deep expertise in at least one major enterprise Linux distribution (RHEL, SUSE) and working knowledge of others
* Broad, hands\-on familiarity with the open\-source infrastructure ecosystem beyond the OS itself (e.g. web/app servers, MySQL, PostgreSQL, message queues, identity providers)
* Strong hands\-on experience with infrastructure\-as\-code and configuration management tools (e.g. Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Terraform)
* Solid understanding of open source OS in Azure cloud and containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience designing for high availability, disaster recovery and backup/restore strategies
* Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, firewalls) as they relate to Linux server environments
* Practical knowledge of Linux security hardening, patch management and compliance frameworks (CIS, ISO 27001, or similar)
* Understanding of open\-source licensing models (GPL, Apache, MIT, etc.) and their implications for enterprise use
* Scripting proficiency (Bash, Python) for automation and tooling
* Experience with monitoring and observability stacks (e.g. Prometheus/Grafana, Nagios, Zabbix, ELK/Splunk)
* Experience with public cloud platforms (Azure), particularly hybrid\-cloud Linux workloads
* Active contribution to or involvement with open\-source projects or communities
* Exposure to enterprise storage architectures (SAN/NAS)
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g. TOGAF)
* Strong architectural and analytical thinking, able to balance technical depth with pragmatic delivery
* Excellent communication skills; comfortable translating complex technical topics for non\-technical stakeholders
* Ownership mentality and ability to work independently in a senior, low\-supervision role
* Collaborative approach to working across infrastructure, security and application teams
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Fluent in English (business level)

Date: 14 Aug 2026
Location:
Jagiroad, AS, IN


Department: Office of TSAT Assam
Business: TSAT India
**About the Business:**
  

  

Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.

  

Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI\-enabled state\-of\-the\-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high\-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence. Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group.

  

The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust.’  

  

  



**Overview:**


The Deputy Manager – Program Management will lead strategic and operational programs supporting the TEPL OSAT Assam plant start\-up, ramp\-up, and manufacturing operations. This role will partner closely with the Program Manager, Business Head, and cross\-functional leadership teams to drive execution excellence, operational readiness, risk management, and stakeholder alignment across multiple business\-critical initiatives.


The position requires a seasoned professional capable of independently managing complex workstreams, driving accountability across functions, resolving escalations, and ensuring timely delivery of key business objectives.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

  



**Program Leadership \& Execution**


* Lead and drive multiple cross\-functional programs and strategic initiatives from planning through execution.


* Develop, maintain, and govern integrated project schedules, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.


* Ensure alignment of project objectives with business priorities and operational requirements.


* Lead reviews, governance forums, and leadership discussions when required.

  

**Strategic Planning \& Decision Support**


* Drive program reviews, executive updates, and governance mechanisms for leadership.


* Conduct scenario analysis, capacity assessments, and decision\-making support for critical business initiatives.


* Prepare executive\-level presentations, business cases, and strategic recommendations.

  

**Risk \& Issue Management**


* Establish and maintain comprehensive risk registers and mitigation plans.


* Proactively identify program risks, resource constraints, and execution challenges.


* Lead escalation management and coordinate timely resolution across stakeholders.

  

**Operational Readiness \& Factory Ramp**


* Drive manufacturing readiness activities for plant start\-up, equipment qualification, new product introduction (NPI), and volume ramp.


* Monitor operational KPIs and readiness metrics across Engineering, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, Facilities, and EHS functions.


* Ensure smooth transition from project execution into sustained operations.

  

**Cross\-Functional Leadership**


* Coordinate and influence cross\-functional teams to achieve program goals.


* Drive accountability through structured action tracking and management reviews.


* Facilitate alignment between Projects, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, Facilities, and Business teams.

  

**Governance \& Performance Management**


* Establish program dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting systems.


* Conduct regular project health reviews and critical path assessments.


* Support development and implementation of PMO best practices and governance frameworks.

  

**Customer \& Stakeholder Engagement**


* Support customer reviews, audits, business visits, and executive presentations.


* Manage communication with internal and external stakeholders.


* Represent Program Management in customer discussions and operational reviews as needed.

  

**Continuous Improvement**


* Lead initiatives focused on operational excellence, process improvements, and productivity enhancement.


* Drive lessons learned, standardization, and implementation of best practices across programs.


* Support digitalization and automation of program management processes and reporting.

  

**Qualifications:**  

  



* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or related discipline.


* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred.


* 10\-15\+ years of experience in Program Management, Manufacturing Operations, Plant Start\-up, Industrial Engineering, PMO, or related leadership roles.


* Experience in Semiconductor, Electronics Manufacturing, Automotive, EMS, OSAT, or other high\-technology manufacturing environments preferred.


* Strong proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Power BI, and data analysis tools.


* PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, or equivalent certification preferred.


* Proven experience managing complex cross\-functional programs with executive stakeholder engagement.


* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, commissioning, risk management, NPI, ramp\-up, and operational readiness processes.

  

**Personal Attributes:**  

  



* Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.


* Excellent leadership, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.


* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving capabilities.


* Ability to independently drive initiatives with limited supervision.


* Executive\-level communication and presentation skills.


* High ownership mindset with strong execution focus.


* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and fast\-changing environments.


* Proven ability to lead through influence rather than direct authority.


* Results\-oriented, resilient, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously

9fd6befc.title: Service Delivery Manager (SDM)
9fd6befc.description:
\| Thiruvananthapuram, KeralaPune, Maharashtra
  
Job Summary
  
  

We are seeking a highly experienced Service Delivery Manager to lead a large\-scale Global Service Desk operation of approximately 600 FTEs based in Trivandrum, Kerala. This is a senior leadership position that owns end\-to\-end service delivery, commercial performance and people leadership for a multi\-geography, multi\-lingual support environment. The successful candidate will bring strategic vision, operational excellence and a demonstrated ability to drive continuous improvement in a dynamic, high\-volume environment. You will be the primary point of accountability to clients and internal leadership for service quality, contractual commitments and transformation outcomes. Job Title \- Service Delivery Manager \- Global Service Desk Work Mode \- Work from Office Experience \- 15\+ years in Global Service Desk Operations
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Service Delivery Ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of the Global Service Desk, ensuring consistent service quality across all supported regions, shifts and channels (voice, chat, email, self\-service and walk\-up). • SLA / KPI Governance — Define, monitor and consistently achieve contractual SLAs, KPIs and XLAs. Drive root cause analysis on breaches, own remediation plans and publish accurate performance reporting to clients and leadership. • Stakeholder Management — Act as the senior escalation point for clients and internal stakeholders. Build trusted relationships with client executives, technology towers, vendors and support functions; lead governance forums, QBRs and service review meetings. • P\&L Management — Own the profit and loss for the account/delivery unit. Manage cost of delivery, pyramid and span optimisation, resource utilisation, budgeting, forecasting and revenue assurance; identify and pursue growth and upsell opportunities. • People Leadership — Lead, coach and develop a large organisation of approximately 600 FTEs through a layered management structure. Own workforce planning, hiring, capability building, engagement, attrition control and succession planning. • Service Desk Automation \& Transformation — Drive the automation and self\-heal agenda — chatbots/virtual agents, AI\-led triage and routing, knowledge\-centred service, ticket avoidance, shift\-left and zero\-touch resolution — to reduce contact volumes and improve end\-user experience. • ITSM \& Process Excellence — Ensure disciplined execution of Incident, Request, Problem, Change and Knowledge Management processes in line with ITIL best practice; own the ServiceNow/ITSM platform roadmap, configuration priorities and data quality from a delivery perspective. • Continuous Improvement \& Quality — Establish a continuous service improvement culture; own CSAT/NPS and end\-user experience outcomes, quality frameworks, audit readiness and compliance with information security and contractual obligations. • Operational Resilience — Ensure business continuity, 24x7 coverage planning, seat and infrastructure readiness, and risk management for a fully work\-from\-office delivery footprint.
  
  

Skill Requirements
  
  

Minimum 15\+ years of Global Service Desk experience in reputed organisations, with significant time in senior delivery leadership roles. • Proven expertise in stakeholder management, including client executive engagement and governance at CXO level. • Strong background in SLA/KPI definition, measurement and service delivery assurance in outsourced/managed services environments. • Demonstrated ability in P\&L management — budgeting, cost optimisation, margin improvement and commercial governance. • Effective people management experience leading large teams; experience managing several hundred FTEs is essential. • Hands\-on experience delivering Service Desk automation initiatives and measurable ticket reduction or shift\-left outcomes. • Excellent working knowledge of ServiceNow / ITSM platforms and ITIL processes; ITIL certification preferred. • Strong analytical, reporting and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational data into executive\-level insight. • Willingness to work from the Trivandrum office and support a 24x7 global operating model.
  
  

Other Requirements
  
  

Experience transitioning or scaling a large global service desk, including transformation or ramp\-up programmes. • Exposure to AI\-led support, observability and experience\-level agreements (XLAs). • Multi\-lingual or multi\-geography support delivery experience. • Relevant certifications such as ITIL v4 Managing Professional, PMP, Six Sigma Green/Black Belt or COPC.

586ee80d.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
586ee80d.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Technical Program Manager
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Transfer Solutions team was created to establish Mastercard as the frontrunner in the fast\-evolving real\-time payments space, and to position Mastercard to be able to incubate the development of new payment flows. The team is responsible for designing, building, and operating the technology that powers Mastercard’s next generation payment applications – Domestic, Cross Border and Bill Payments.
   

  

 Mastercard seeks to define a world beyond cash. To accelerate this mission, we are committed to building \& scaling products \& applications that transform payments of any type. Real time payment technology is central to this strategy.
   

  

**The Role**
 What’s it all about and what we expect you to do day to day?
   

  

* Exhibits the behaviours of Lean Management and help multiple teams embrace agile process of Scrum, Kanban and Extreme Programming.
* Support multiple teams with implementation of agile rules \- rules of scrum, build in quality and limiting work in progress.
* Trained as a team facilitator and is continuously engaged in challenging the old norms of development to improve performance in the areas of quality, predictability, flow, and velocity.
* Enable cadence and Synchronization across multiple teams so the individual team’s backlogs and solutions are understood, resolved, and integrated.
* Close collaboration with the product management to keep the backlog healthy, groomed and purged.
* Organizes and accelerates a group of related product engineering backlog items or activities across multiple teams, aligning dependent organizations. Identify and remove blockers and always find the path forward in challenging situations
* Creates mechanisms to effectively report out and control execution. Recognizes complexity and creates predictable delivery paths for large and/or complex efforts. Measurably improves, streamlines, and/or eliminates excess processes. Utilizes cross organizational mechanisms to describe and drive continuous improvements.
* Drives execution of an outcome from inception through successful delivery through the full stack of the services / domains, or, an outcome that spans multiple teams and integrations across the enterprise.
* Looked to as first point of contact for your team or area. and Maintains the backlogs as transparent source of truth for status providing the right information and associated data visually about the state backlog of


 the project to the right all the audience at the right all times. Maintains backlogs as always on information radiators on batch size and flow of work.
   

  

* Understands the business strategy and design approaches within product, program or domain with depth to be credible and effective with teams they work with. Can competently and independently represent team’s services.
* Keeps abreast of evolving technology landscape. Can ask the right questions to evaluate the strengths and weaknesses of designs (scalability, latency, security, performance, data integrity, etc.)
* Works with ambiguity and with limited guidance. The business outcome, program, and/or product strategy is defined, but nothing else is. Able to get the inertia out and the epic in motion or able to get the entropy out and start the agile ceremonies for a calm and predictable delivery pattern
* Transform raw thoughts into clear and concise communications/instructions to the teams through backlog grooming. Can communicate with confidence 3\+ levels up using transparent backlog.
* May work directly with external to the organization or external to Mastercard technology providers that support our implementation plans and backlogs roadmaps identifying opportunities to be faster, better and cheaper.
* Understands the needs of the engineers and technical operations teams who have to build, maintain, and operate the services and technical assets
* Regularly review metrics and proactively seek out new and improved data/mechanisms for visibility ensuring your program stays aligned with organization objectives
* Plays active role in mentoring and recruiting others


**All About You And What You Need To Bring**
* Expert with agile deliver using Lean Product management, Lean Management and DevOps practices.
* Run and manage agile process – grooming, planning, prioritization and retrospectives.
* Anticipate bottlenecks, risk and dependencies. Adequately using agile practice to unblock, ROAM Risks and eliminate dependencies to create flow of work.
* Determine if success metrics are in place and if not, you work to define them
* Recognize discordant views and take part in constructive dialog to resolve them
* Continuously assess product development life cycle and software development lifecycle to improve concurrent project delivery.
* Streamline and/or eliminate excess process in any area of the architecture, production operations environment, or business area where the same efforts (or issues) are repeated year\-over\-year
* Experienced in agile and modern SDLC practices (Scrum/Kanban/Continuous Delivery/DevOps/Quality engineering) and the delivery situations they are used for
* Has skills to conduct product demos and co\-ordinate with product owners to drive product acceptance signoffs
* Have software engineering or product management experience and background


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 The ideal candidate will possess strong knowledge of the
 **Microsoft Partner Center** 
 ,
 **Azure services and subscriptions** 
 , cloud operations, billing and provisioning processes, and partner lifecycle management.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct regular partner service reviews and health check meetings.

* Proactively identify potential service risks and ensure timely corrective actions.

* Billing and payment health
* Consumption and usage trends
* Expiring subscriptions or commitments
* Partner Center account hygiene
* Customer and subscription mapping
* Required administrative access and permissions
* Azure plan and billing configuration
* Potential service suspension or disruption risks

* Work closely with internal operations, billing, finance, technical support, and Microsoft teams to prevent service disruptions.
* Ensure timely resolution of issues related to:
* Azure subscription provisioning
* Service suspension
* Billing discrepancies
* Payment\-related issues
* Partner Center administration
* Customer subscription management
* Access and permission\-related challenges
* Own the end\-to\-end coordination and escalation process for critical partner issues until resolution.
* Microsoft Partner Center Management
* Demonstrate strong working knowledge of the Microsoft Partner Center portal and associated cloud operational processes.
* Support partners in maintaining proper Partner Center hygiene and administration.
* Review partner account configurations and identify potential operational risks.
* Guide partners on best practices related to:
* CSP and Azure customer management
* Subscription administration
* Azure Plan management
* Customer lifecycle management
* Partner relationships and access
* User roles and permissions
* Billing and invoicing processes
* Stay updated on Microsoft Partner Center changes, policies, processes, and operational requirements.
* Partner Health Reviews \& Governance

* Weekly operational reviews for critical partners
* Monthly partner health checks
* Quarterly business and service reviews
* Maintain a Partner Health Scorecard covering key operational and service parameters.
* Track open actions, risks, escalations, and resolution timelines.
* Present regular service health updates to internal leadership and relevant stakeholders.
* Develop corrective action plans for partners with recurring operational or hygiene challenges.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination
* Work closely with internal teams, including:
* Azure Business Development
* Cloud Operations
* Technical Support
* Pre\-Sales
* Finance and Credit
* Billing Operations
* Partner Management
* Microsoft Alliance and Vendor Teams
* Act as the central coordinator for partner service\-related escalations.
* Ensure clear ownership, timely follow\-up, and closure of partner issues.
* Escalation \& Incident Management
* Manage critical service escalations for assigned partners.
* Ensure appropriate prioritization and timely escalation to internal or Microsoft support teams.
* Track incidents through to closure and provide regular updates to stakeholders.
* Conduct root cause reviews for recurring or critical operational issues.
* Recommend preventive measures to minimize future service disruptions.
* Reporting \& Continuous Improvement
* Develop and maintain dashboards for:
* Partner Health Status
* Open Service Issues
* Escalation Aging
* Subscription and Billing Health
* Azure Consumption Trends
* Hygiene Compliance
* Risk Indicators
* Identify recurring partner challenges and recommend process improvements.
* Contribute to the development of standardized Azure operational processes, SOPs, and best practices.
* Drive automation and simplification initiatives to improve the partner service experience.


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
**Technical \& Product Knowledge**
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure products, services, and cloud concepts.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of the Microsoft Partner Center portal.
* Understanding of the Microsoft CSP ecosystem and Azure operational lifecycle.
* Knowledge of Azure subscriptions, Azure Plan, billing, provisioning, and customer management.
* Understanding of cloud service continuity and incident management.
* Ability to interpret Azure consumption, subscription, and operational data.
* Familiarity with Microsoft support and escalation processes.


**Functional Skills**
* Strong partner relationship and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical abilities.
* Strong ownership and ability to manage issues end\-to\-end.
* Ability to work across multiple internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong reporting, dashboard, and data analysis capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple partner accounts and priorities simultaneously.


**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 3–8 years of relevant experience in Microsoft Cloud, Azure operations, cloud support, service management, CSP operations, or partner management.
* Experience working with a Microsoft Distributor, Indirect Provider, CSP, System Integrator, or Managed Service Provider will be preferred.
* Experience managing strategic partners or enterprise customer service operations is desirable.


**Certification Requirements**
 The candidate should hold, or be willing to obtain, relevant Microsoft Azure certifications.

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ\-900\) – Mandatory baseline knowledge.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ\-104\) – Highly preferred.
* Additional Azure or Microsoft Cloud certifications will be an advantage.

The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a Cloud Security \- Cyber \- Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding our clients' cloud environments by designing and implementing security measures across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS platforms. Your work will involve collaborating with Cloud Service Providers to establish security protocols, monitor for potential breaches, and conduct risk assessments to protect sensitive data. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate complex situations, grow your personal brand, and deepen your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions even when the path forward is unclear.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of our Cybersecurity practice, focusing on protecting organizations from cyber threats through advanced technologies and strategies. You will stay updated with the latest security threats and trends in cloud technology, using your critical thinking to break down complex concepts and develop secure systems. This position offers an opportunity to enhance your skills in a dynamic environment, contributing to the security posture of our clients while advancing your career within our Cybersecurity practice.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Designing and implementing security protocols across cloud environments including IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS
* Conducting risk assessments and vulnerability testing to identify potential security breaches
* Collaborating with Cloud Service Providers to elevate security posture and safeguard sensitive data
* Monitoring cloud\-based systems for security threats and staying updated with the latest trends in cloud technology
* Utilizing analytical thinking to break down complex security concepts and develop proactive solutions
* Managing cloud infrastructure architecture design to optimize security and performance
* Leading forensic investigations and incident management to address security events effectively
* Developing security frameworks and controls to maintain professional and technical standards
* Building meaningful client connections and guiding teams in navigating complex cybersecurity challenges


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree

1ed6b718.title: Medical AI Research Program Manager
1ed6b718.description:
Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amritapuri Campus is inviting applications from qualified candidates for the post of Medical AI Research Program Manager
  
**For Details Contact:** hr\-cybersecurity@am.amrita.edu
  
Apply Now
  
  

Job Title
  
Medical AI Research Program Manager
  
  

Required Number
  
1
  
  

Qualification
  
  

Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, computer science, biomedical/life sciences, healthcare, management, or a related field
  
  

Experience coordinating multidisciplinary, technical, research, or healthcare projects
  
  

Working literacy in machine\-learning workflows — data collection, annotation, training, evaluation, validation. You won't build models, but you must be able to follow (and question) a discussion about them.
  
  

Excellent written and verbal communication; strong attention to detail and follow\-through
  
  

The ability to turn broad, ambiguous objectives into clear, actionable plans
  
  

Job Description
  
  

Seeking applications from candidates who can lead multidisciplinary AI healthcare projects, coordinate clinicians and engineers, manage timelines, publications, and deliver AI solutions that improve patient care. Job responsibilities include:
  
  

Running the engineering cadence. Daily stand\-ups with the ML team, sprint planning, retrospectives — keeping five engineers (plus student researchers) unblocked, prioritized, and honest about progress.
  
  

Running the clinical interface. Doctors join us every two weeks. You prepare those meetings, capture what the clinicians actually need (which is not always what they first say), and translate it into requirements engineers can build against — then translate results back into language clinicians trust.
  
  

Owning the plans. Turning ambiguous research goals ("can we predict severity from these videos?") into milestones, owners, and timelines — and updating them when reality disagrees, which it will.
  
  

Protecting the deadlines. Conference submissions run this lab's calendar. You track them, work back from them, and raise the alarm early when a project is quietly drifting off course.
  
  

Sharpening the output. Reviewing manuscripts, reports, and proposals for clarity and consistency. You are often the last set of eyes before something leaves the building.
  
  

Asking the uncomfortable question. When a result looks too good, when two people are measuring different things, when "almost done" has been almost done for three weeks — noticing is your job. You don't need to solve the technical problem; you need to make sure it can't hide.
  
  

Job Category
  
Project
  
  

Last Date to Apply
  
August 17, 2026

**About RightCrowd**
 RightCrowd is a global leader in Physical Identity and Access Management (PIAM), providing award\-winning solutions that automate the lifecycle of cardholders and their credentials, enforce security and safety policies, and support compliance requirements. Our solutions help organizations eliminate access chaos and reduce risk while enhancing operational efficiency.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 As an Associate Solution Architect, you will play a key role in delivering and configuring RightCrowd’s software solutions for enterprise customers. You will be responsible for understanding client requirements, leading technical onboarding, supporting integrations with physical access control systems (PACS), and ensuring a seamless go\-live. This is a highly collaborative role that combines technical expertise, client\-facing communication, and project coordination. This is a remote position.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the end\-to\-end implementation process for new customers—from discovery to deployment
* Conduct requirements gathering workshops with enterprise clients to understand business needs
* Configure RightCrowd software solutions to meet customer\-specific requirements
* Integrate with third\-party systems including PACS (e.g., Lenel, HID, Genetec), HRIS, and IT directories
* Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and account teams to ensure timely and high\-quality delivery
* Provide technical guidance, documentation, and training to clients and internal stakeholders
* Troubleshoot and resolve implementation\-related issues during project delivery
* Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and post\-go\-live stabilization
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, ensuring long\-term adoption and value realization


**Qualifications**

41691421.title: Technical Architect
41691421.description:
**Job Description: Technical Architect at Anchanto India**
**Location:** 
 Pune, India \|
 **Experience:** 
 10 to 15 years \|
 **Seniority** 
 : Senior Individual Contributor / Architect
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Enterprise B2B SaaS / Global Commerce / Supply Chain Technology
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Technical Architect who can own the technical architecture across two of Anchanto's most critical products OXM (Order Experience Management) and OMS (Order Management System). This is a senior individual contributor role with deep ownership of system design, scalability, reliability, and AI\-powered capability delivery. You will be the technical authority across both platforms, ensuring architectural coherence, engineering standards, and a clear path to scale as Anchanto grows globally. This is not a hands\-off advisory role. You will be deeply involved in design decisions, code reviews, incident resolution, and driving the engineering teams toward better patterns, faster delivery, and higher quality with AI as a force multiplier across the SDLC.
   

  

 Anchanto is a global B2B SaaS company powering commerce for brands, retailers, logistics companies and enterprises. Our customers rely on it to realize 100% of their revenue on a daily basis. The platform is used by 300\+ customers brands, retailers, and logistics providers, processes 150M\+ orders annually, and serves thousands of users across operations teams in 12 countries including France, UK, Singapore, Malaysia and UAE.
   

  

**What Will Your Day Look Like?**
* Own architecture across OXM and OMS \- lead system design for new capabilities, define integration patterns, and ensure both platforms evolve coherently as business requirements change.
* Design and evolve event\-driven, distributed systems \- ensure scalability, fault tolerance, multi\-tenant isolation, and idempotency across AWS (SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Lambda, ECS/EKS, Aurora, DynamoDB, Redis).
* Lead AI capability architecture \- design the technical foundation for AI\-powered features inside OXM and OMS intelligent order routing, anomaly detection, demand forecasting, agentic workflows and ensure they meet enterprise\-grade reliability, security, and cost standards.
* Partner with Engineering Managers and Tech Leads \- translate product requirements into technical blueprints, unblock design bottlenecks, and ensure engineering teams have clear architectural guidance before execution begins.
* Own cross\-platform integration standards \- define API versioning, contract testing, rate limiting, and deprecation policies so OXM and OMS interoperate cleanly and third\-party integrations are reliable at scale.
* Contribute to engineering productivity \- identify and eliminate architectural toil, reduce system complexity where it creates delivery friction, and drive DORA metric improvement through better system design


**Skills And Experience Needed For This Job**
* Deep expertise in Node.js \- async processing, high\-throughput APIs, event\-driven microservices at scale
* Strong working knowledge of Ruby on Rails \- MVC patterns, ActiveRecord, background jobs (Sidekiq), API design, and performance optimisation
* Hands\-on experience with AWS\- EC2, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Lambda, ECS/EKS, Aurora/PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, ElastiCache/Redis, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch
* System design depth \- multi\-tenant architecture, idempotency, retries, backpressure, failure isolation, and distributed transaction patterns
* Proven track record of designing systems with 99\.9%\+ uptime and sub\-200ms P95 latency
* Strong API design \- RESTful, GraphQL, contract testing, versioning, and integration reliability
* Database expertise – MySQL, PostgreSQL, Aurora, DynamoDB, Redis; query optimisation, indexing strategies, schema design for high\-throughput workload.
* Familiarity with AI coding tools \- Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot as productivity multipliers in the SDLC
* Secure SDLC, SAST/DAST, secret scanning, dependency audits, OWASP Top 10, threat modelling


**How You Will Build At Anchanto**
* You will be the technical conscience of OXM and OMS \- the person engineering teams come to when they need to make the right call, not just the fast one.
* You will make AI a real part of how we build not a side project by architecting AI\-powered features inside our products and enabling engineers to use AI tools as a default, not an exception.
* You will treat scalability, reliability, and cost as first\-class design constraints not afterthoughts across every system you touch.
* You will work with Engineering Managers to ensure teams have clear technical direction before they start building, reducing mid\-sprint surprises and rework.
* You will hold the bar high every API, every schema, every integration pattern should be something we're proud to still have in production two years from now.


**What Success Looks Like**
- Reliability: ≥ 99\.9% uptime for owned services.

 Performance: \< 200ms P95 latency for critical APIs.
 - AI Delivery: At least one AI\-powered capability shipped inside OXM or OMS within 6 months

- Quality: reduction in P1/P2 incidents and MTTR; improving DORA metrics quarter over quarter.

- Platform Standardization: Containerisation and observability standards adopted across both platforms.

- Cost: No unexpected cost blowouts on architectural decisions include cost modelling

**Leadership \& Ownership traits you must have**
* Own the technical architecture of OXM and OMS end\-to\-end from design to production to incident
* Make technical trade\-oﬀ calls with clarity and confidence speed vs. correctness, cost vs. scale, build vs. buy
* Drive architectural alignment across engineering teams without formal authority, influence through reasoning, documentation, and trust
* Proactively identify and surface technical risk before it becomes a production problem
* Mentor Tech Leads and Senior Engineers on system design, architectural thinking, and engineering standards
* Partner with Engineering Managers and Product to ensure roadmap decisions are technically grounded and deliverable


**Behaviours / Personal Qualities**
* Outcome Ownership: You don't just design systems, you care whether they work in production, at scale, for real customer
* Systems Thinking: You naturally consider failure modes, dependencies, edge cases, and second\-order eﬀects before they become someone else's incident.
* Execution Discipline: You follow through. RFCs get written. ADRs get documented. Decisions don't disappear into Slack threads.
* Adaptability: You can work across Node.js and Ruby on Rails stacks, switching context between two distinct platforms without losing depth on either.
* Raising the Bar: You set a standard for what good looks like \- in code, in design, in documentation and you hold it consistently.

* Work closely with implementation partners, account managers, clients, vendors and internal recruitment teams.
* Attend requirement calls and understand technical skills, location, work authorization, rate, duration and client expectations.

* Establish daily, weekly and monthly submission, interview and placement targets.

* Develop reliable candidate and vendor pipelines for recurring and high\-priority requirements.

* Monitor recruiter activity through ATS, CRM, VMS, trackers and delivery dashboards.
* Analyze submission\-to\-interview, interview\-to\-offer and offer\-to\-joining ratios.
* Conduct daily team meetings, pipeline reviews, performance reviews and recruiter training.
* Identify delivery gaps and implement corrective actions to improve turnaround time and candidate quality.
* Coordinate interview scheduling, feedback collection, offer negotiation and onboarding.
* Maintain regular communication with account managers and implementation partners regarding delivery status.
* Handle escalations related to candidate quality, rate, documentation, interview attendance and joining.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable U.S. staffing requirements.
* Prepare accurate daily, weekly and monthly management reports.



 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in business, Human Resources, Engineering, Technology or a related field.
* 8\+ years of U.S. staffing and recruitment experience.
* At least 2–3 years of experience as a Delivery Manager, Recruitment Manager or Account Manager.
* Strong experience working on implementation\-partner requirements.
* Hands\-on experience with C2C recruitment and consultant\-employer management.
* Strong understanding of W2, C2C, 1099, contract\-to\-hire and full\-time hiring models.
* Knowledge of U.S. work authorizations, including USC, Green Card, H\-1B, H\-4 EAD, L\-2 EAD, TN, OPT and STEM OPT.
* Experience managing recruiters and performance targets.
* Strong understanding of IT and engineering requirements.
* Experience using ATS, CRM and VMS platforms.
* Strong Boolean search, candidate sourcing and vendor\-networking knowledge.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong negotiation, problem\-solving and escalation\-management abilities.
* Advanced recruitment data\-management and reporting skills.
* Ability to work during U.S. business hours.

088fc25b.title: Solution Engineer (Post Sales)
088fc25b.description:
**Hevo Data** 




**Solution Engineer (Post\-sales)** 




**About Hevo** 




 DoorDash, Footlocker, Arhaus, Santander, and thousands of other data\-driven companies have one thing in common. They all use Hevo Data’s fully managed Automated Pipelines to consolidate their data from multiple sources like Databases, Marketing Applications, Cloud Storage, SDKs, Streaming Services, etc.
 



 We are a San Francisco, Bangalore, and Pune\-based company with 2000\+ customers spread across 45\+ countries in e\-commerce, financial technology, and healthcare. Strongly backed by marquee investors like Sequoia Capital, we have raised $42 Million to date and are looking forward to our next phase of hyper\-growth!
 



**Why do we exist?** 




 At Hevo, our mission is to enable every company to be data\-driven. We started on this journey 9 years back, and as the first step in this direction, we built our first product – “Data Pipeline” or simply “Pipeline”.
 



 Hevo Pipeline is a no\-code platform that helps companies connect all their sources of data within the company to get a unified view of their business. The platform offers integrations with 150\+ data sources such as Databases, SaaS applications, Advertising Channels, etc.
 



 Today, we enable close to 2000 companies across more than 40\+ countries to be more data\-driven. Our aim is to make the technology so simple that anyone should be able to solve their data problems and not be limited due to their lack of technical skills.
 



**The Role** 




 We are growing into mid\-market and enterprise accounts where the technical bar \- and the stakes \- are higher. To win and retain these customers, we are building the technical depth in our post\-sale motion to match.
 



 Enterprise buyers are not just buying a product. They are making architectural decisions. The CTOs, data architects, and engineering leads we work with at this level need a technical counterpart.
 



 As a Solution Engineer, you are that person. You are not the first point of contact, and you are not handling tickets.
 



 You are the expert our Account Managers bring in when a customer conversation goes beyond relationship management \- a quarterly architecture review, a complex integration challenge, a strategic expansion decision, or simply when a CTO wants to talk to someone who really knows data.
 



**What You Will Do** 



* Be the senior technical specialist that Account Managers call on for complex customer conversations \- architecture reviews, expansion discussions, and senior\-level technical engagements.
* Engage credibly with CTOs, senior engineers, and data architects as a genuine thought partner: understand their architecture, challenge assumptions, co\-design pipelines, and offer a credible point of view.
* Lead technical discovery and solution design for enterprise customers evaluating new use cases, migrations, or architectural changes involving Hevo.
* Translate complex customer requirements into actionable guidance \- both for the customer and, where needed, and for Hevo's internal engineering team.
* Build and maintain deep expertise in the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses, orchestration, transformation, and the broader ecosystem Hevo operates within.
* Identify expansion opportunities through technical engagement and hand them off to the AM with enough context to move the conversation forward commercially.
* Contribute to internal knowledge \- documenting patterns, building reference architectures, and raising the technical bar across the post\-sales team.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




**Required** 



* 6\+ years of experience in a technical, customer\-facing role \- Solutions Engineering, Data Engineering, or a technical post\-sale or consulting function.
* Deep, broad knowledge of data engineering: ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), orchestration, and the modern data stack.
* Hands\-on experience with data integration tools, CDC, event streaming, or warehouse\-native transformation (dbt, etc.).
* Demonstrable ability to engage at the architectural level \- not just explain a product, but understand and speak to a customer's data infrastructure.
* Strong communication skills: you can make complex technical ideas clear to both engineers and executives, and you are confident pushing back when a customer's approach is suboptimal.
* Comfort working in an ambiguous, fast\-moving environment with a small team and high autonomy.



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience in a pre\-sales or post\-sales SE role at a data infrastructure or SaaS company.
* Exposure to enterprise data governance, compliance, or security requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA).
* Prior experience in a startup or high\-growth B2B SaaS environment.



  





**What You Will Not Be Doing** 




 This is not a support role, a ticket\-handling role, or a general customer success role. You will not be measured on ticket volume or response SLAs. You will be measured on whether enterprise customers trust Hevo at the technical level \- and whether that trust translates into deeper, longer, larger relationships.
 



**What We Offer** 



* Competitive compensation and/or equity.
* Direct access to leadership and real influence on how the post\-sale function is built.
* A collaborative, high\-trust environment where technical depth is valued and rewarded.

e3be29b8.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
e3be29b8.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Technical Program Manager
Who is Mastercard?  

  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  

  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  

  

Overview:  

  

The Transfer Solutions team was created to establish Mastercard as the frontrunner in the fast\-evolving real\-time payments space, and to position Mastercard to be able to incubate the development of new payment flows. The team is responsible for designing, building, and operating the technology that powers Mastercard’s next generation payment applications – Domestic, Cross Border and Bill Payments.  

  

Mastercard seeks to define a world beyond cash. To accelerate this mission, we are committed to building \& scaling products \& applications that transform payments of any type. Real time payment technology is central to this strategy.  

  

The Role:  

  

What’s it all about and what we expect you to do day to day?  

  

* Exhibits the behaviours of Lean Management and help multiple teams embrace agile process of Scrum, Kanban and Extreme Programming.

  

* Support multiple teams with implementation of agile rules \- rules of scrum, build in quality and limiting work in progress.

  

* Trained as a team facilitator and is continuously engaged in challenging the old norms of development to improve performance in the areas of quality, predictability, flow, and velocity.

  

* Enable cadence and Synchronization across multiple teams so the individual team’s backlogs and solutions are understood, resolved, and integrated.

  

* Close collaboration with the product management to keep the backlog healthy, groomed and purged.

  

* Organizes and accelerates a group of related product engineering backlog items or activities across multiple teams, aligning dependent organizations. Identify and remove blockers and always find the path forward in challenging situations

  

* Creates mechanisms to effectively report out and control execution. Recognizes complexity and creates predictable delivery paths for large and/or complex efforts. Measurably improves, streamlines, and/or eliminates excess processes. Utilizes cross organizational mechanisms to describe and drive continuous improvements.

  

* Drives execution of an outcome from inception through successful delivery through the full stack of the services / domains, or, an outcome that spans multiple teams and integrations across the enterprise.

  

* Looked to as first point of contact for your team or area. and Maintains the backlogs as transparent source of truth for status providing the right information and associated data visually about the state backlog of

  

the project to the right all the audience at the right all times. Maintains backlogs as always on information radiators on batch size and flow of work.  

  

* Understands the business strategy and design approaches within product, program or domain with depth to be credible and effective with teams they work with. Can competently and independently represent team’s services.

  

* Keeps abreast of evolving technology landscape. Can ask the right questions to evaluate the strengths and weaknesses of designs (scalability, latency, security, performance, data integrity, etc.)

  

* Works with ambiguity and with limited guidance. The business outcome, program, and/or product strategy is defined, but nothing else is. Able to get the inertia out and the epic in motion or able to get the entropy out and start the agile ceremonies for a calm and predictable delivery pattern

  

* Transform raw thoughts into clear and concise communications/instructions to the teams through backlog grooming. Can communicate with confidence 3\+ levels up using transparent backlog.

  

* May work directly with external to the organization or external to Mastercard technology providers that support our implementation plans and backlogs roadmaps identifying opportunities to be faster, better and cheaper.

  

* Understands the needs of the engineers and technical operations teams who have to build, maintain, and operate the services and technical assets

  

* Regularly review metrics and proactively seek out new and improved data/mechanisms for visibility ensuring your program stays aligned with organization objectives

  

* Plays active role in mentoring and recruiting others

  

All About You and What you need to bring:  

  

* Expert with agile deliver using Lean Product management, Lean Management and DevOps practices.

  

* Run and manage agile process – grooming, planning, prioritization and retrospectives.

  

* Anticipate bottlenecks, risk and dependencies. Adequately using agile practice to unblock, ROAM Risks and eliminate dependencies to create flow of work.

  

* Determine if success metrics are in place and if not, you work to define them

  

* Recognize discordant views and take part in constructive dialog to resolve them

  

* Continuously assess product development life cycle and software development lifecycle to improve concurrent project delivery.

  

* Streamline and/or eliminate excess process in any area of the architecture, production operations environment, or business area where the same efforts (or issues) are repeated year\-over\-year

  

* Experienced in agile and modern SDLC practices (Scrum/Kanban/Continuous Delivery/DevOps/Quality engineering) and the delivery situations they are used for

  

* Has skills to conduct product demos and co\-ordinate with product owners to drive product acceptance signoffs

  

* Have software engineering or product management experience and background

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, process transformation, and AI engineering.  As a critical member of AgentOps, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, AI\-powered workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and ROI objectives.

* Solution Design Documents (SDDs)
